meaning: s. in a foreign country; r. to or in a foreign country
translation_zh: adv. 往国外, 到室外, 到处；a. 往国外的, 在室外的, 广泛四散的
example: She spoke abroad during the meeting.

meaning: v. consider or hold as true; v. receive willingly something given or offered; v. give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to; v. react favorably to; consider right and proper
translation_zh: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍；vi. 同意
example: I accept your apology.

meaning: a. worthy of acceptance or satisfactory; s. judged to be in conformity with approved usage; s. adequate for the purpose
translation_zh: a. 可接受的, 合意的, 可忍受的
example: Children must learn socially acceptable behaviour.

meaning: n. an unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury; n. anything that happens suddenly or by chance without an apparent cause
translation_zh: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面；[化] 意外事故; 事故
example: There was a car accident on the highway.

meaning: r. to the opposite side; r. transversely
translation_zh: prep. 越过, 穿过, 与...相交叉, 在...的对面；adv. 交叉, 到另一边, 在对面, 成十字
example: She spoke across during the meeting.

meaning: n. a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body; n. something that people do or cause to happen; n. a subdivision of a play or opera or ballet; n. a short theatrical performance that is part of a longer program
translation_zh: n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案；vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当；vt. 扮演, 装作；[计] 先进通信技术, 先进计算机工艺, 自动代码翻译技术
example: He decided to act quickly.

meaning: n. something done (usually as opposed to something said); n. the state of being active; n. the series of events that form a plot; n. the trait of being active and energetic and forceful
translation_zh: n. 行动, 活动, 动作, 作用, 战斗, 行为, 诉讼；vt. 对...起诉；[计] 方式
example: We need to take action now.

meaning: n. a person who is a participating member of an organization; a. tending to become more severe or wider in scope; s. engaged in or ready for military or naval operations; a. disposed to take action or effectuate change
translation_zh: a. 活跃的, 起作用的, 积极的, 有效的, 主动的, 活性的, 现行的, 现役的；n. 主动语态, 积极分子
example: She leads a very active lifestyle.

meaning: n. any specific behavior; n. (chemistry) the capacity of a substance to take part in a chemical reaction
translation_zh: n. 活动, 行动, 活跃, 活力；[计] 活动
example: Reading is a relaxing activity.

meaning: n. a theatrical performer; n. a person who acts and gets things done
translation_zh: n. 男演员, 行动者；[医] 作用物, 反应物
example: The actor performed well in the play.

meaning: n. (computer science) the code that identifies where a piece of information is stored; n. the place where a person or organization can be found or communicated with; n. the act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience; n. the manner of speaking to another individual
translation_zh: n. 住址, 演说, 举止, 灵巧, 求爱；vt. 发表(演说或讲话), 对付, 写地址；[计] 地址, 寻址
example: Please write down your address.

meaning: n. a word that expresses an attribute of something; n. the word class that qualifies nouns; a. relating to court practice and procedure as opposed to the principles of law
translation_zh: n. 形容词；a. 形容词的, 从属的
example: "Reliable" is not an adjective that could be applied to my car.

meaning: v. alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard; v. adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions; v. make correspondent or conformable; v. decide how much is to be paid on an insurance claim
translation_zh: vt. 调整, 使适应于, 校准；vi. 适应于, 被调节, 相互熟悉而适应
example: We need to adjust this carefully.

meaning: v. feel admiration for; v. look at with admiration
translation_zh: vt. 赞美, 钦佩, 爱慕；vi. 称赞, 惊奇
example: We need to admire this carefully.

meaning: n. a fully developed person from maturity onward; n. any mature animal; s. (of animals) fully developed
translation_zh: n. 成人, 成虫；a. 成年的, 成熟的
example: Children must be accompanied by an adult.

meaning: s. farther along in physical or mental development; s. comparatively late in a course of development; s. ahead of the times; s. at a higher level in training or knowledge or skill
translation_zh: a. 在前的, 高级的, 先进的, 年老的；[法] 预付的, 预支的, 垫付的
example: Scientists are working on highly advanced technology to replace fossil fuels.

meaning: n. a wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)
translation_zh: n. 冒险, 冒险经历；v. 冒险
example: Going on a safari was a great adventure.

meaning: n a public promotion of some product or service
translation_zh: n. 广告, 启事, 广告宣传；[法] 广告, 公告, 告示
example: You can place an advertisement on a classifieds website.

meaning: v. inform (somebody) of something
translation_zh: vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议；vi. 提意见, 商量
example: We need to advise this carefully.

meaning: a. filled with fear or apprehension; s. filled with regret or concern; used often to soften an unpleasant statement; s. feeling worry or concern or insecurity; s. having feelings of aversion or unwillingness
translation_zh: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的
example: I'm afraid of spiders.

meaning: n. a native or inhabitant of Africa; a. of or relating to the nations of Africa or their peoples
translation_zh: n. 非洲人；a. 非洲的, 非洲人的
example: She loves African music.

meaning: s. located farther aft; r. behind or in the rear
translation_zh: prep. 在...之后, 由于；conj. 在...之后；adv. 后来
example: She spoke after during the meeting.

meaning: prep. Abreast; opposite to; facing; towards; as, against the; mouth of a river; -- in this sense often preceded by over.; prep. From an opposite direction so as to strike or come in; contact with; in contact with; upon; as, hail beats against the roof.; prep. In opposition to, whether the opposition is of; sentiment or of action; on the other side; counter to; in contrariety; to; hence, adverse to; as, against reason; against law; to run a race; against time.; prep. By of before the time that; in preparation for; so as; to be ready for the time when.
translation_zh: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠
example: We're playing against the league champions next week.

meaning: n. people who are old collectively; s. advanced in years; (`aged' is pronounced as two syllables); s. at an advanced stage of erosion (pronounced as one syllable); s. having attained a specific age; (`aged' is pronounced as one syllable)
translation_zh: a. 老的, 陈的, 有...岁的；[化] 老化的; 老化了的; 陈化的; 陈化了的
example: They have two children aged six and nine.

meaning: v. be in accord; be in agreement; v. consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something; v. show grammatical agreement; v. be agreeable or suitable
translation_zh: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合；vt. 承认, 认定, 同意
example: We all agree on the plan.

meaning: s. having the leading position or higher score in a contest; r. at or in the front; r. toward the future; forward in time; r. in a forward direction
translation_zh: a. 领先的, 预先的, 向前的；adv. 领先, 预先, 向前, 胜于, 在前面, 在将来
example: Go straight ahead.

meaning: n. a mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of; n. the region above the ground; n. a distinctive but intangible quality surrounding a person or thing; n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles)
translation_zh: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度；vt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀
example: The air is fresh today.

meaning: n. a long narrow passage (as in a cave or woods); n. passageway between seating areas as in an auditorium or passenger vehicle or between areas of shelves of goods as in stores; n. part of a church divided laterally from the nave proper by rows of pillars or columns
translation_zh: n. 走廊, 侧廊, 过道；[机] 走道
example: Please walk down the aisle to your seat.

meaning: n. fear resulting from the awareness of danger; n. a device that signals the occurrence of some undesirable event; n. an automatic signal (usually a sound) warning of danger; v. warn or arouse to a sense of danger or call to a state of preparedness
translation_zh: n. 惊恐, 警报, 警钟；vt. 使惊恐, 警告；[计] 报警信号
example: She decided to sound the alarm (= warn people that the situation was dangerous).

meaning: alarm clock
translation_zh: 闹钟
example: The alarm clock was important for everyone.

meaning: n. one or more recordings issued together; originally released on 12-inch phonograph records (usually with attractive record covers) and later on cassette audiotape and compact disc; n. a book of blank pages with pockets or envelopes; for organizing photographs or stamp collections etc
translation_zh: n. 粘贴簿, 唱片套；[医] 白色物
example: She bought the new album by her favorite band.

meaning: a. possessing life; s. (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit; s. (followed by `to' or `of') aware of; s. capable of erupting
translation_zh: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
example: Is the plant still alive?

meaning: a. quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class; s. completely given to or absorbed by
translation_zh: a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的；adv. 全部, 全然；pron. 全部；n. 全部
example: All students passed the exam.

meaning: s. isolated from others; s. lacking companions or companionship; s. exclusive of anyone or anything else; s. radically distinctive and without equal
translation_zh: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的；adv. 独自地
example: She likes to be alone sometimes.

meaning: r. with a forward motion; r. in accompaniment or as a companion; r. to a more advanced state; r. in addition (usually followed by `with')
translation_zh: adv. 平行地, 向前；prep. 沿着
example: We walked along the beach.

meaning: r. prior to a specified or implied time
translation_zh: adv. 已经, 早已
example: I have already finished my homework.

meaning: s. nonstandard usage
translation_zh: a. 没问题的
example: Are you alright? You look a bit pale.

meaning: conj. Grant all this; be it that; supposing that;; notwithstanding; though.
translation_zh: conj. 虽然, 尽管
example: Although the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.

meaning: s. surprising greatly; s. inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
translation_zh: a. 令人惊异的
example: The view from the mountain was amazing.

meaning: n. a cherished desire; n. a strong drive for success; v. have as one's ambition
translation_zh: n. 野心, 志向
example: She had fulfilled her lifelong ambition.

meaning: prep. Alt. of Amongst
translation_zh: prep. 在...之中
example: They strolled among the crowds.

meaning: n. the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion; v. be tantamount or equivalent to
translation_zh: n. 总数, 总额；vi. 总计, 等同
example: A large amount of work is needed.

meaning: s. pleasantly occupied
translation_zh: a. 愉快的, 被逗乐的
example: This is a very amused situation.

meaning: n. a feeling of delight at being entertained
translation_zh: n. 兴味, 娱乐, 消遣；[法] 娱乐, 娱乐活动
example: She could not hide her amusement at the way he was dancing.

meaning: n. someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
translation_zh: n. 祖先, 祖宗
example: His ancestors had come to America from Ireland.

meaning: n. spiritual being attendant upon God; n. invests in a theatrical production; n. the highest waterfall; has more than one leap; flow varies seasonally
translation_zh: n. 天使, 守护神, 善人
example: John is no angel, believe me (= he does not behave well).

meaning: r. with anger
translation_zh: adv. 愤怒地
example: She spoke angrily during the meeting.

meaning: n. a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus
translation_zh: n. 踝；[医] 踝, 踝关节
example: She twisted her ankle playing soccer.

meaning: v. cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
translation_zh: vt. 使恼怒, 骚扰
example: We need to annoy this carefully.

meaning: s. causing irritation or annoyance
translation_zh: a. 恼人的, 讨厌的
example: This is a very annoying situation.

meaning: s. any of various alternatives; some other
translation_zh: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的；pron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个
example: We've still got another (= a further) forty miles to go.

meaning: s. eagerly desirous; s. causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
translation_zh: a. 忧虑的, 发愁的, 渴望的
example: The bus was late and Sue began to get anxious.

meaning: r. at or in or to any place; (`anyplace' is used informally for `anywhere')
translation_zh: adv. 无论何处
example: I can't find my keys anywhere.

meaning: n. a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house
translation_zh: n. 房间, 公寓
example: They live in a small apartment in the city.

meaning: v defend, explain, clear away, or make excuses for by reasoning; v acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing
translation_zh: vi. 道歉（等于apologize）
example: You should apologise for your rude behaviour.

meaning: v. acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing; v. defend, explain, clear away, or make excuses for by reasoning
translation_zh: vi. 道歉, 辩解
example: You should apologize for your rude behavior.

meaning: v. come into sight or view; v. be issued or published; v. seem to be true, probable, or apparent; v. come into being or existence, or appear on the scene
translation_zh: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到；[法] 出庭, 到案, 出现
example: He didn't appear to be happy.

meaning: v. be pertinent or relevant or applicable; v. ask (for something); v. refer (a word or name) to a person or thing; v. apply oneself to
translation_zh: vt. 涂, 应用；vi. 申请, 适用
example: You should apply for the job by Friday.

meaning: n. the act of putting a person into a non-elective position; n. (usually plural) furnishings and equipment (especially for a ship or hotel); n. the job to which you are (or hope to be) appointed; n. (law) the act of disposing of property by virtue of the power of appointment
translation_zh: n. 约会, 委任的职位, 委派；[经] 任命, 派, 指定
example: I have an appointment with the doctor at 3 PM.

meaning: n. an architectural product or work; n. the discipline dealing with the principles of design and construction and ornamentation of fine buildings; n. the profession of designing buildings and environments with consideration for their esthetic effect
translation_zh: n. 建筑学, 建筑式样；[计] 体系结构
example: She's a professor of architecture at the University of Oregon.

meaning: n. a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography); n. a subject of study; n. a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve; n. a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function
translation_zh: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地；[计] 区域
example: This is a quiet area.

meaning: v. present reasons and arguments; v. have an argument about something; v. give evidence of
translation_zh: vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论；vt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服
example: They often argue about politics.

meaning: n. chair with a support on each side for arms
translation_zh: n. 扶手椅
example: He relaxed in his favorite armchair by the fireplace.

meaning: a. (used of persons or the military) characterized by having or bearing arms; a. having arms or arms as specified; used especially in combination; a. (used of plants and animals) furnished with bristles and thorns
translation_zh: a. 有扶手的, 武装的, 有防卫器官的；[法] 武装的, 持械的, "F带武器的
example: This is a very armed situation.

meaning: r. by a circular or circuitous route; r. in a circle or circular motion; r. to a particular destination either specified or understood; r. in circumference
translation_zh: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处；adv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处
example: We walked around the park.

meaning: n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively; n. the creation of beautiful or significant things; n. a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation
translation_zh: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术；[计] 实际保持时间, 特许权和资源表, 平均检索时间, 平均运行时间
example: She loves visiting art galleries.

meaning: n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication; n. one of a class of artifacts; n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will); n. (grammar) a determiner that may indicate the specificity of reference of a noun phrase
translation_zh: n. 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约；[计] 信件
example: I read an interesting article online.

meaning: a. contrived by art rather than nature; s. artificially formal; s. not arising from natural growth or characterized by vital processes
translation_zh: a. 人造的, 假的, 非原地产的；[医] 人工的, 人造的, 伟牟
example: A job interview is a very artificial situation.

meaning: n. a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination
translation_zh: n. 艺术家, 画家
example: Pablo Picasso was a famous artist.

meaning: n a very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar; n a United States territory on the eastern part of the island of Samoa; n a metric unit of length equal to one ten billionth of a meter (or 0.0001 micron); used to specify wavelengths of electromagnetic radiation; n any of several fat-soluble vitamins essential for normal vision; prevents night blindness or inflammation or dryness of the eyes; n one of the four nucleotides used in building DNA; all four nucleotides have a common phosphate group and a sugar (ribose); n (biochemistry) purine base found in DNA and RNA; pairs with thymine in DNA and with uracil in RNA; n the basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; n the 1st letter of the Roman alphabet; n the blood group whose red cells carry the A antigen; r to the same degree (often followed by `as')
translation_zh: adv. 同样地, 例如；prep. 做为, 当作；conj. 当...之时, 以...的方式, 像...一样, 因为；[计] 高级系统, 先进系统, 辅助存储器, 自治系统
example: They were all dressed as clowns.

meaning: a. in a state of sleep; s. lacking sensation; s. dead; r. into a sleeping state
translation_zh: a. 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的；adv. 熟睡地
example: The baby is fast asleep.

meaning: n. a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
translation_zh: n. 助手, 助理, 助教；a. 有帮助的, 辅助的, 助理的
example: My assistant will call you back.

meaning: n. a person trained to travel in a spacecraft
translation_zh: n. 太空旅行者, 宇航员；[法] 美国太空人
example: The astronaut orbited the Earth.

meaning: n. a person trained to compete in sports
translation_zh: n. 运动员, 运动选手；[医] 运动员
example: The athlete trained hard for the Olympics.

meaning: n. (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element; n. (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
translation_zh: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量；[计] 原子
example: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.

meaning: v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.; v. take charge of or deal with; v. to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result; v. give heed (to)
translation_zh: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随；vi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席
example: She decided to attend the university in London.

meaning: a. pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm; s. having power to arouse interest; a. having the properties of a magnet; the ability to draw or pull;
translation_zh: a. 吸引人的, 有魅力的；[法] 有吸引力的, 有迷惑力的
example: She is a very attractive person.

meaning: n. a native or inhabitant of Australia; n. the Austronesian languages spoken by Australian aborigines; a. of or relating to or characteristic of Australia or its inhabitants or its languages
translation_zh: n. 澳大利亚人；a. 澳大利亚的, 澳洲的, 澳洲人的
example: My friend is Australian.

meaning: a. operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control; s. resembling the unthinking functioning of a machine; s. without volition or conscious control
translation_zh: n. 自动手枪, 自动机械；a. 自动的, 机械的, 必然的, 无意识的
example: My camera has manual and automatic functions.

meaning: s. not present; having left; a. used of an opponent's ground; s. (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter; r. from a particular thing or place or position (`forth' is obsolete)
translation_zh: adv. 离去
example: Go away from here!

meaning: s. causing fear or dread or terror
translation_zh: a. 可怕的, 庄严的, 虔敬的
example: The weather was awful yesterday.

meaning: n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine; n. the part of something that is furthest from the normal viewer; n. (football) a person who plays in the backfield; n. the part of a garment that covers the back of your body
translation_zh: a. 后面的；vt. 使后退, 支持；vi. 倒退, 背靠；adv. 向后地；n. 背部, 后面
example: Please go back to your seat.

meaning: r. to a severe or serious degree; r. evilly or wickedly; r. in a disobedient or naughty way; r. with great intensity (`bad' is a nonstandard variant for `badly')
translation_zh: adv. 严重地, 恶劣地, 极度地
example: He played badly in the first half of the game.

meaning: n. a game played on a court with light long-handled rackets used to volley a shuttlecock over a net
translation_zh: n. 羽毛球运动
example: They played a game of badminton in the park.

meaning: v. cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven; v. prepare with dry heat in an oven; v. be very hot, due to hot weather or exposure to the sun
translation_zh: vt. 烘焙, 烤；vi. 烤面包；n. 烘焙, 烤
example: She loves to bake cakes for her friends.

meaning: n. an upper floor projecting from the rear over the main floor in an auditorium; n. a platform projecting from the wall of a building and surrounded by a balustrade or railing or parapet
translation_zh: n. 阳台, 戏院楼厅
example: We enjoyed the view from the hotel balcony.

meaning: n. large tough nonrigid bag filled with gas or heated air; n. small thin inflatable rubber bag with narrow neck; v. ride in a hot-air balloon; v. become inflated
translation_zh: n. 气球；vt. 使成气球状；vi. 膨胀如气球, 激增
example: A thousand balloons were released to mark the event.

meaning: n. instrumentalists not including string players; n. a stripe or stripes of contrasting color; n. an adornment consisting of a strip of a contrasting color or material; n. a range of frequencies between two limits
translation_zh: n. 带子, 队, 乐队；v. 联合, 结合；[计] 频带; 波段; 区
example: My favorite band is playing tonight.

meaning: n. sloping land (especially the slope beside a body of water); n. a long ridge or pile; n. an arrangement of similar objects in a row or in tiers; n. a supply or stock held in reserve for future use (especially in emergencies)
translation_zh: n. 银行, 堤, 岸；[医] 库
example: I need to go to the bank.

meaning: n. engaging in the business of keeping money for savings and checking accounts or for exchange or for issuing loans and credit etc.; n. transacting business with a bank; depositing or withdrawing funds or requesting a loan etc.
translation_zh: n. 银行业务；[经] 银行业, 银行事务
example: She's thinking about a career in banking.

meaning: n. a counter where you can obtain food or drink; n. a rigid piece of metal or wood; usually used as a fastening or obstruction or weapon; n. an obstruction (usually metal) placed at the top of a goal; n. (meteorology) a unit of pressure equal to a million dynes per square centimeter
translation_zh: n. 条, 棒, 酒吧, 栅, 障碍物；vt. 禁止, 阻挡, 妨碍；[计] 棒形图
example: We met at the bar for a drink.

meaning: n. meat that has been barbecued or grilled in a highly seasoned sauce; n. a cookout in which food is cooked over an open fire; especially a whole animal carcass roasted on a spit; n. a rack to hold meat for cooking over hot charcoal usually out of doors
translation_zh: n. 烤肉；vt. 烤肉, 烧烤
example: We're having a barbecue in the garden this Saturday.

meaning: n. United States composer (1910-1981); n. a hairdresser who cuts hair and shaves beards as a trade; v. perform the services of a barber: cut the hair and/or beard of
translation_zh: n. 理发师
example: I need to go to the barber for a haircut.

meaning: n. an agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each; n. an advantageous purchase; v. come to terms; arrive at an agreement
translation_zh: n. 交易, 买卖协定, 特价商品；v. 讲价, 交易
example: I picked up a few good bargains in the sale.

meaning: n. a ball game played with a bat and ball between two teams of nine players; teams take turns at bat trying to score runs; n. a ball used in playing baseball
translation_zh: n. 棒球；[计] 棒球系统
example: My favorite sport is baseball.

meaning: n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn; an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code; no longer in general use; n. (usually plural) a necessary commodity for which demand is constant; a. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis; s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality
translation_zh: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律；a. 基本的, 碱性的；(计算机)BASIC语言
example: He has a basic understanding of the subject.

meaning: n. a container that is usually woven and has handles; n. the quantity contained in a basket; n. horizontal circular metal hoop supporting a net through which players try to throw the basketball; n. a score in basketball made by throwing the ball through the hoop
translation_zh: n. 篮, 篮子；vt. 装入篮
example: Click to drop items into your shopping basket.

meaning: n. all the loaves of bread baked at the same time; n. (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent; n. a collection of things or persons to be handled together; v. batch together; assemble or process as a batch
translation_zh: n. 一次所烘的面包, 一次所制之量, 一组, 批, 成批, 分批；v. 成批, 分批处理；[计] 一批
example: Each summer a new batch of students tries to find work.

meaning: n. group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place; n. a device that produces electricity; may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series; n. a collection of related things intended for use together; n. a unit composed of the pitcher and catcher
translation_zh: n. 电池, 殴打；[化] 蓄电池
example: My phone battery is low.

meaning: n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman; n. a single pulsation of an oscillation produced by adding two waves of different frequencies; has a frequency equal to the difference between the two oscillations; n. the sound of stroke or blow; n. a regular rate of repetition
translation_zh: n. 心跳(声), 打, 敲打声, 拍子；v. 打, 拍打, 打败；a. 疲乏的, 颓废的；beat的过去式；[计] 拍; 节拍
example: Our team can beat them.

meaning: n. the qualities that give pleasure to the senses; n. an outstanding example of its kind
translation_zh: n. 美, 美人
example: The beauty of the sunset was breathtaking.

meaning: v have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun); v be identical to; be someone or something; v occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere; v have an existence, be extant; v happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"; v be identical or equivalent to; v form or compose; v work in a specific place, with a specific subject, or in a specific function; v represent, as of a character on stage; v spend or use time; v have life, be alive; v to remain unmolested, undisturbed, or uninterrupted -- used only in infinitive form; v be priced at
translation_zh: be的过去分词
example: The been was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops
translation_zh: n. 啤酒；[化] 啤酒
example: Would you like a glass of beer?

meaning: r earlier in time; previously; r at or in the front
translation_zh: prep. 在...之前；conj. 在...之前；adv. 在前
example: She spoke before during the meeting.

meaning: v. call upon in supplication; entreat; v. ask to obtain free; v. dodge, avoid answering, or take for granted
translation_zh: v. 乞求, 乞讨, 请求
example: We need to beg this carefully.

meaning: n someone new to a field or activity; n a person who founds or establishes some institution
translation_zh: n. 初学者
example: This class is perfect for absolute beginners.

meaning: n. the event consisting of the start of something; n. the time at which something is supposed to begin; n. the first part or section of something; n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being
translation_zh: n. 开始
example: This is just the beginning.

meaning: n the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances; n (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people; n (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation; n manner of acting or controlling yourself
translation_zh: n. 行为, 举止；[计] 特性, 性能, 特点, 行为, 动作, 状态
example: His behaviour at the party was unacceptable.

meaning: n. the state or fact of existing
translation_zh: n. 存在, 性质, 生命, 人, 生物, be的现在分词
example: The Irish Free State came into being in 1922.

meaning: v. accept as true; take to be true; v. be confident about something; v. follow a credo; have a faith; be a believer; v. credit with veracity
translation_zh: v. 相信
example: I believe in you.

meaning: n. a protruding abdomen; n. a part that bulges deeply; n. the hollow inside of something; n. the underpart of the body of certain vertebrates such as snakes or fish
translation_zh: n. 腹部, 食欲；vt. 使鼓起；vi. 鼓起, 匍匐前进
example: The baby lay on its belly.

meaning: v. be owned by; be in the possession of; v. be suitable or acceptable; v. be in the right place or situation; v. be rightly classified in a class or category
translation_zh: vi. 属于, 合适
example: This book belongs on the top shelf.

meaning: n. endless loop of flexible material between two rotating shafts or pulleys; n. a band to tie or buckle around the body (usually at the waist); n. an elongated region where a specific condition or characteristic is found; n. ammunition (usually of small caliber) loaded in flexible linked strips for use in a machine gun
translation_zh: n. 带子, 地带；[医] 带, 腰带, 束带, 地带, 区
example: He tightened his belt after eating too much.

meaning: n. a long seat for more than one person; n. the magistrate or judge or judges sitting in court in judicial capacity to compose the court collectively; n. the reserve players on a team; n. (law) the seat for judges in a courtroom
translation_zh: n. 长椅子；[机] 台
example: His lawyer turned to address the bench.

meaning: r. making an additional point; anyway; besides, we can't afford it"; r. in addition
translation_zh: prep. 除...之外；adv. 而且, 此外
example: She spoke besides during the meeting.

meaning: n. something superior in quality or condition or effect; n. a superior person having claim to precedence; n. the superior one of two alternatives; v. surpass in excellence
translation_zh: a. 较好的；adv. 比较好
example: We're hoping for better weather tomorrow.

meaning: r. farther along in space or time or degree; r. on the farther side from the observer; r. in addition
translation_zh: prep. 超过, 在那一边, 迟于；adv. 在远处；n. 更远处
example: The road continues beyond the village up into the hills.

meaning: n. a statute in draft before it becomes law; n. an itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered; n. a piece of paper money (especially one issued by a central bank); n. the entertainment offered at a public presentation
translation_zh: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据；vt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布
example: Can I have the bill, please?

meaning: n. the time when something begins (especially life); n. the event of being born; n. a baby born; an offspring
translation_zh: n. 出生, 起源；[医] 生产, 分娩
example: The birth of her child changed her life.

meaning: n. a small fragment of something broken off from the whole; n. piece of metal held in horse's mouth by reins and used to control the horse while riding; n. a unit of measurement of information (from binary + digit); the amount of information in a system having two equiprobable states; n. the part of a key that enters a lock and lifts the tumblers
translation_zh: n. 少量, 马嚼子, 辅币；vt. 给马上嚼子, 控制；bite的过去式和过去分词；[计] 比特, 二进制数位, 机内测试
example: Can I have a bit of cake?

meaning: n. a wound resulting from biting by an animal or a person; n. a light informal meal; n. (angling) an instance of a fish taking the bait; n. the act of gripping or chewing off with the teeth and jaws
translation_zh: n. 咬, 一口；v. 咬, 刺痛, 穿透
example: The dog gave a playful bite.

meaning: n. sheet of slate; for writing with chalk
translation_zh: n. 黑板
example: The teacher wrote the new vocabulary words on the blackboard.

meaning: n. bedding that keeps a person warm in bed; n. anything that covers; n. a layer of lead surrounding the highly reactive core of a nuclear reactor; v. cover as if with a blanket
translation_zh: n. 毛毯, 毯子；vt. 掩盖, 覆盖；a. 总共的
example: The baby was wrapped in a blanket.

meaning: n. a solid piece of something (usually having flat rectangular sides); n. a rectangular area in a city surrounded by streets and usually containing several buildings; n. a three-dimensional shape with six square or rectangular sides; n. a number or quantity of related things dealt with as a unit
translation_zh: n. 街区, 木块, 石块, 块；vt. 阻塞, 封锁, 使成块状；[计] 块, 数据块
example: The building is one block away.

meaning: n a person with fair skin and hair; n a light grayish yellow to near white; a being or having light colored skin and hair and usually blue or grey eyes
translation_zh: a. (头发)亚麻色的, 淡色的, 白肤金发碧眼的, 白里透红的, 白皙的, 淡黄色的；n. 肤色白皙的金发女人
example: She has beautiful blonde hair.

meaning: n. the best time of youth; n. a rosy color (especially in the cheeks) taken as a sign of good health; v. produce or yield flowers
translation_zh: n. 花, 开花, 青春, 钢块；vi. 开花, 焕发青春, 茂盛；vt. 使茂盛, 把...轧成钢坯
example: The plant produced a single white bloom.

meaning: n. a powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon; n. an impact (as from a collision); n. forceful exhalation through the nose or mouth; v. exhale hard
translation_zh: n. 吹, 打击, 殴打, 花开；v. 吹, 风吹, 吹响, 开花
example: The wind began to blow strongly.

meaning: n. a committee having supervisory powers; n. a stout length of sawn timber; made in a wide variety of sizes and used for many purposes; n. a flat piece of material designed for a special purpose; n. food or meals in general
translation_zh: n. 木板, 甲板, 膳食, 会议桌；vt. 乘船, 供膳食, 用板覆盖；vi. 搭伙；[计] 板
example: Write it on the board.

meaning: board game
translation_zh: n. 用棋盘玩的游戏
example: The board game was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a painful sore with a hard core filled with pus; v. come to the boiling point and change from a liquid to vapor; v. immerse or be immersed in a boiling liquid, often for cooking purposes; v. bring to, or maintain at, the boiling point
translation_zh: n. 煮沸, 沸腾, 疖；v. 煮沸, 激动
example: Please boil some water for the tea.

meaning: s. cooked in hot water
translation_zh: a. 煮沸的, (非正式)喝醉的, 烧滚的
example: This is a very boiled situation.

meaning: n. rigid connective tissue that makes up the skeleton of vertebrates; n. the porous calcified substance from which bones are made; n. a shade of white the color of bleached bones; v. remove the bones from
translation_zh: n. 骨头, 骨, 骨制品；vt. 剔骨；vi. 专心致志
example: The dog buried its bone in the garden.

meaning: n. anything that tends to arouse; n. an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
translation_zh: n. 奖金, 红利；[经] 奖金, 红利, 额外补贴
example: What is actually paid will depend on the bonus payments made at the end of the policy.

meaning: n. a piece of furniture with shelves for storing books
translation_zh: n. 书架, 书柜
example: She arranged her books neatly on the new bookcase.

meaning: n. a shelf on which to keep books
translation_zh: n. 书架
example: She arranged her favorite novels neatly on the bookshelf.

meaning: n. a shop where books are sold
translation_zh: n. 书店
example: I spent hours browsing in the old bookshop.

meaning: s. tired of the world
translation_zh: a. 无聊的；烦人的；无趣的
example: There was a bored expression on her face.

meaning: n. a person responsible for hiring workers; n. a person who exercises control and makes decisions; s. exceptionally good
translation_zh: n. 老板, 上司, 岩瘤, 浮雕, 母牛；vt. 指挥, 控制, 浮雕
example: My boss gave me a new project.

meaning: n. the lower side of anything; n. the lowest part of anything; n. the second half of an inning; while the home team is at bat; n. a cargo ship
translation_zh: n. 底部；a. 底部的；vt. 给...装底, 查明真相；vi. 到达底部, 建立基础
example: The book fell to the bottom of the stairs.

meaning: n. a man who is the lover of a girl or young woman
translation_zh: n. 男朋友
example: She introduced me to her new boyfriend.

meaning: n an undergarment worn by women to support their breasts
translation_zh: n. 奶罩；[化] 左矢; 刁
example: She bought a new bra.

meaning: v. try to solve a problem by thinking intensely about it
translation_zh: n. 灵机一动；v. 集体讨论
example: The brainstorm was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a restraint used to slow or stop a vehicle; n. any of various ferns of the genus Pteris having pinnately compound leaves and including several popular houseplants; n. an area thickly overgrown usually with one kind of plant; n. anything that slows or hinders a process
translation_zh: n. 刹车, 阻碍, 丛林；v. 刹车
example: He pressed the brake pedal.

meaning: n. a division of some larger or more complex organization; n. a division of a stem, or secondary stem arising from the main stem of a plant; n. a part of a forked or branching shape; n. a stream or river connected to a larger one
translation_zh: n. 树枝, 支店, 支流, 分部；vi. 分支, 出枝；vt. 分割, 用枝状叶脉刺绣花纹装饰；[计] 分支, 目录分支
example: A bird was sitting on a branch of the tree.

meaning: n. a North American Indian warrior; n. people who are brave; a. possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching; s. brightly colored and showy
translation_zh: a. 勇敢的, 美好的, 华丽的；n. 勇敢者；vt. 勇敢地面对
example: The brave firefighter rescued the cat from the tree.

meaning: n. an unexpected piece of good luck; n. the occurrence of breaking; n. an abrupt change in the tone or register of the voice (as at puberty or due to emotion); n. the opening shot that scatters the balls in billiards or pool
translation_zh: n. 休息, 中断, 破裂处, 绝交, 破晓, 突变；vt. 打破, 弄破, 弄坏, 破坏, 违反, 打断, 削弱, 放弃；vi. 破碎, 决裂, 破晓, 突变, 变弱, 暂停；n. 分隔符；[计] 分隔符; 中断; DOS内部命令:设定扫描中断按键的时机
example: Let's take a short break.

meaning: n. the process of taking in and expelling air during breathing; n. the air that is inhaled and exhaled in respiration; n. a short respite; n. a slight movement of the air
translation_zh: n. 呼吸, 气息, 瞬间；[医] 呼气, 呵气, 口气, 呼吸
example: Take a deep breath and relax.

meaning: n. a slight wind (usually refreshing); v. blow gently and lightly; v. to proceed quickly and easily
translation_zh: n. 微风, 煤屑, 轻而易举的事；vi. 吹微风, 逃走
example: The flowers were gently swaying in the breeze.

meaning: n. a woman who has recently been married; n. a woman participant in her own marriage ceremony
translation_zh: n. 新娘
example: The bride looked beautiful in her white dress.

meaning: n. a structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.; n. a circuit consisting of two branches (4 arms arranged in a diamond configuration) across which a meter is connected; n. something resembling a bridge in form or function; n. the hard ridge that forms the upper part of the nose
translation_zh: n. 桥, 舰桥, 桥梁, 桥牌；vt. 架桥于, 跨越；[计] 桥, 网桥, 桥接器
example: We walked across the old stone bridge.

meaning: a. emitting or reflecting light readily or in large amounts; s. having striking color; s. characterized by quickness and ease in learning; s. having lots of light either natural or artificial
translation_zh: a. 明亮的, 聪明的, 鲜明的, 欢快的；adv. 明亮地, 欢快地
example: The sun was very bright this morning.

meaning: n. an orange of low brightness and saturation; n. Scottish botanist who first observed the movement of small particles in fluids now known a Brownian motion (1773-1858); n. abolitionist who was hanged after leading an unsuccessful raid at Harper's Ferry, Virginia (1800-1859); v. fry in a pan until it changes color
translation_zh: n. 褐色；a. 褐色的；v. (使)变褐色
example: The dog has brown fur.

meaning: n. general term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate; n. a fault or defect in a computer program, system, or machine; n. a small hidden microphone; for listening secretly
translation_zh: n. 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人；vt. 装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒；vi. 捉虫, 暴突；[计] 缺点, 错误
example: There's a bug crawling up your arm.

meaning: v. build or establish something abstract; v. improve the cleansing action of; v. order, supervise, or finance the construction of; v. give form to, according to a plan
translation_zh: v. 建立, 建筑；n. 构造, 体格
example: They plan to build a new house.

meaning: n. a modified bud consisting of a thickened globular underground stem serving as a reproductive structure; n. a rounded part of a cylindrical instrument (usually at one end); n. anything with a round shape resembling a teardrop; n. a rounded dilation or expansion in a canal or vessel or organ
translation_zh: n. 球茎, 电灯泡；[医] 球, 鳞茎, 球茎
example: The light bulb in the lamp needs to be replaced.

meaning: n. pain that feels hot as if it were on fire; n. an injury caused by exposure to heat or chemicals or radiation; n. a place or area that has been burned (especially on a person's body); n. damage inflicted by fire
translation_zh: vt. 烧, 烧毁, 烧伤；vi. 燃烧, 发热, 烧毁；n. 烧伤, 烙印
example: Be careful not to burn yourself.

meaning: v. cover from sight; v. place in a grave or tomb; v. place in the earth and cover with soil; v. embed deeply
translation_zh: vt. 埋葬, 埋藏
example: We need to bury this carefully.

meaning: bus station
translation_zh: n. 公交车站
example: The bus station was important for everyone.

meaning: bus stop
translation_zh: 公共汽车站
example: I was waiting at the bus stop.

meaning: n. a large wilderness area; n. 43rd President of the United States; son of George Herbert Walker Bush (born in 1946); n. United States electrical engineer who designed an early analogue computer and who led the scientific program of the United States during World War II (1890-1974); n. vice president under Reagan and 41st President of the United States (born in 1924)
translation_zh: n. 矮树丛；[化] 管衬
example: There's a rose bush growing by the fence.

meaning: n. a commercial or industrial enterprise and the people who constitute it; n. a rightful concern or responsibility; n. an immediate objective; n. the volume of commercial activity
translation_zh: n. 生意, 事情, 业务, 商业, 商行, 职责；[经] 企业, 商业, 营业
example: She started her own business.

meaning: n. a person engaged in commercial or industrial business (especially an owner or executive)
translation_zh: n. 商人, 实业家, 工商业家
example: My father is a businessman.

meaning: n. a female businessperson
translation_zh: n. 商人, 办理实务的人, 经商者
example: She is a successful businesswoman who owns several companies.

meaning: n. a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits; n. small two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage; with two seats and a folding hood; n. a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
translation_zh: n. 出租车, 出租汽车, 出租马车；vi. 乘出租马车(或汽车)
example: Let's take a cab to the airport.

meaning: n. a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
translation_zh: n. 自助餐厅；[经] 自助餐厅
example: We usually eat lunch in the school cafeteria.

meaning: n. a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year; n. a list or register of events (appointments or social events or court cases etc); n. a tabular array of the days (usually for one year); v. enter into a calendar
translation_zh: n. 日历, 日程表；vt. 列入表中；[计] 日历
example: Check the calendar for the date.

meaning: n. a telephone connection; n. a special disposition (as if from a divine source) to pursue a particular course; n. a demand especially in the phrase "the call of duty"; n. a brief social visit
translation_zh: n. 呼叫, 访问, 打电话, 号召, 召集, 要求；vt. 呼叫, 召集, 打电话；vi. 叫喊, 访问, 叫牌；[计] 调用; 呼叫; DOS内部命令:在批处理文件中调用另一个批处理文件
example: I will call you later.

meaning: v. make calm or still; v. become quiet or calm, especially after a state of agitation; s. not agitated; without losing self-possession; a. (of weather) free from storm or wind
translation_zh: n. 平稳, 风平浪静；a. 平静的, 冷静的；vi. 平静下来, 镇静；vt. 使平静
example: The sea was calm this morning.

meaning: n. temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers; n. a group of people living together in a camp; n. temporary lodgings in the country for travelers or vacationers; n. a penal institution (often for forced labor)
translation_zh: n. 露营, 帐篷；vi. 露营, 扎营；vt. 使扎营
example: We set up our camp near the river.

meaning: n. the act of encamping and living in tents in a camp
translation_zh: n. 野营, 露营
example: We went camping in the mountains.

meaning: n. airtight sealed metal container for food or drink or paint etc.; n. the quantity contained in a can; n. a buoy with a round bottom and conical top; v. preserve in a can or tin
translation_zh: vt. 装罐；n. 罐头, 容器；aux. 能, 可以；[计] 作废字符
example: I can swim.

meaning: n. a tight-fitting headdress; n. a top (as for a bottle); n. something serving as a cover or protection; n. a fruiting structure resembling an umbrella or a cone that forms the top of a stalked fleshy fungus such as a mushroom
translation_zh: n. 盖子, 帽子；vt. 戴帽子, 覆盖, 胜过；vi. 脱帽致意；[计] 调用程序分析, 容量, 代码分析程序, 计算机辅助生产, 计算机辅助印刷
example: He wore a baseball cap.

meaning: capital letter
translation_zh: [计] 大写字母
example: The capital letter was important for everyone.

meaning: car park
translation_zh: n. 停车场
example: The car park was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something; n. a cause for feeling concern; n. attention and management implying responsibility for safety; n. activity involved in maintaining something in good working order
translation_zh: n. 小心, 照料, 忧虑；vi. 关心, 介意；vt. 在意, 喜欢
example: I care about my family.

meaning: a. exercising caution or showing care or attention; s. cautiously attentive; s. unhurried and with care and dignity; s. full of cares or anxiety
translation_zh: a. 小心的, 谨慎的
example: Be careful when crossing the road.

meaning: n. deep orange edible root of the cultivated carrot plant; n. perennial plant widely cultivated as an annual in many varieties for its long conical orange edible roots; temperate and tropical regions; n. orange root; important source of carotene; n. promise of reward as in "carrot and stick";
translation_zh: n. 胡萝卜；[医] 胡萝卜
example: They are holding out a carrot of $120 million in economic aid.

meaning: n. money in the form of bills or coins; n. prompt payment for goods or services in currency or by check; n. United States country music singer and songwriter (1932-2003); v. exchange for cash
translation_zh: n. 现金；vt. 兑现
example: Do you have any cash on you?

meaning: n. a container that holds a magnetic tape used for recording or playing sound or video
translation_zh: n. 盒式磁带, 珠宝箱, 暗盒；[计] 字盒
example: I remember listening to their first album on cassette.

meaning: n. a large building formerly occupied by a ruler and fortified against attack; n. (chess) the piece that can move any number of unoccupied squares in a direction parallel to the sides of the chessboard; n. interchanging the positions of the king and a rook; v. move the king two squares toward a rook and in the same move the rook to the square next past the king
translation_zh: n. 城堡, 象棋中的车；vt. 置于城堡中, 盘踞于
example: We visited an old castle on our trip.

meaning: n. a drawback or difficulty that is not readily evident; n. the quantity that was caught; n. a person regarded as a good matrimonial prospect; n. anything that is caught (especially if it is worth catching)
translation_zh: n. 捕捉, 陷阱, 捕捉之物, 抓, 拉手；vt. 捕捉, 赶上, 感染, 听清楚；vi. 抓住, 燃着
example: He tried to catch the ball.

meaning: v. have a celebration
translation_zh: v. 庆祝, 祝贺, 举行
example: We will celebrate her birthday next weekend.

meaning: n. a fractional monetary unit of several countries
translation_zh: n. 分；[经] 美分
example: I only have a few cents left.

meaning: n. an area that is approximately central within some larger region; n. a building dedicated to a particular activity; n. a point equidistant from the ends of a line or the extremities of a figure
translation_zh: n. 中心, 中心点, 中锋；a. 中央的, 位在正中的；vt. 集中, 定中心；vi. 居中；[计] 居中; 中央
example: The city center is very busy.

meaning: n. a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter
translation_zh: n. 厘米；[医] 厘米
example: The ruler was marked in centimeters.

meaning: n a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter
translation_zh: n. 厘米, 公分
example: Bangkok is sinking at the rate of up to five centimetres (two inches) a year, and the entire city may be below sea level by 2050.

meaning: n. a low-lying region in central France
translation_zh: n. 中心, 中心点, 中锋；a. 中央的, 位在正中的；vt. 集中, 定中心；vi. 居中
example: The city centre is very busy.

meaning: n. grass whose starchy grains are used as food: wheat; rice; rye; oats; maize; buckwheat; millet; n. a breakfast food prepared from grain; a. made of grain or relating to grain or the plants that produce it
translation_zh: n. 谷类食品, 谷类植物；a. 谷类的
example: Wheat, rice, and corn are cereals.

meaning: s. definite but not specified or identified; a. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured; a. established beyond doubt or question; definitely known; a. certain to occur; destined or inevitable
translation_zh: a. 确定的, 某一个的, 必然的；[法] 确凿的, 无疑的, 可靠的
example: Are you certain about your decision?

meaning: r definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
translation_zh: adv. 确定地
example: I will certainly help you.

meaning: n. a white sparkling wine either produced in Champagne or resembling that produced there; n. a region of northeastern France
translation_zh: n. 香槟酒, 香槟酒色；[化] 香槟酒
example: There are a number of fine champagnes (= types of champagne) available at very reasonable prices.

meaning: n. an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another; n. a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event; n. the action of changing something; n. the result of alteration or modification
translation_zh: n. 变化, 找回的零钱, 找头, 更换；vt. 改变, 更换, 兑换
example: The weather can change quickly.

meaning: n. a subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled; n. any distinct period in history or in a person's life; n. a local branch of some fraternity or association; n. an ecclesiastical assembly of the monks in a monastery or even of the canons of a church
translation_zh: n. 章, 篇, 重要章节；[计] 章; 段
example: Read the first chapter of the book.

meaning: n. an informal conversation
translation_zh: n. 闲谈；vi. 闲谈, 聊天
example: We had a nice chat over coffee.

meaning: a. relatively low in price or charging low prices; s. embarrassingly stingy
translation_zh: a. 便宜的, 不值钱的, 可鄙的；adv. 便宜地
example: The clothes in this shop are very cheap.

meaning: n. a written order directing a bank to pay money; n. the bill in a restaurant; n. the act of inspecting or verifying; n. a mark left after a small piece has been chopped or broken off of something
translation_zh: n. 检查, 支票, 阻止物, 寄物牌, 象棋中将军；vt. 检查, 阻止, 核对, 寄存, 托运；vi. 逐项相符, 开支票；[计] 复选
example: Please check your answers carefully.

meaning: n. either side of the face below the eyes; v. speak impudently to
translation_zh: n. 颊, 厚颜, 脸蛋；[医] 颊
example: He kissed her on both cheeks.

meaning: n. a cry or shout of approval; v. give encouragement to; v. show approval or good wishes by shouting; v. cause (somebody) to feel happier or more cheerful
translation_zh: n. 愉快, 振奋, 欢呼；vi. 欢呼, 喝彩, 快活起来；vt. 使振奋, 欢呼
example: We need to cheer this carefully.

meaning: n. a professional cook
translation_zh: n. 厨师
example: The chef prepared a delicious meal.

meaning: v. withdraw money by writing a check
translation_zh: n. 支票
example: I paid for it by cheque.

meaning: n. weedy annual native to Europe but widely distributed as a weed especially in wheat; n. a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules; the object is to checkmate the opponent's king
translation_zh: n. 国际象棋；[建] 雀麦
example: Do you want to play a game of chess?

meaning: n. box with a lid; used for storage; usually large and sturdy
translation_zh: n. 胸, 胸部, 衣柜, 箱子；[医] 胸, 胸廓
example: He felt a pain in his chest.

meaning: n. the time of person's life when they are a child; n. the state of a child between infancy and adolescence
translation_zh: n. 孩童时期；[医] 儿童期
example: She had a happy childhood.

meaning: n. ground beef and chili peppers or chili powder often with tomatoes and kidney beans; n. very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency
translation_zh: n. 干辣椒, 辣椒粉
example: I like to add a little chili to my food for extra spice.

meaning: n very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency
translation_zh: n. 红辣椒
example: This dish is very spicy because it has a lot of chilli.

meaning: n. intelligent somewhat arboreal ape of equatorial African forests
translation_zh: n. 黑猩猩；[医] 黑猩猩
example: The chimpanzee was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the protruding part of the lower jaw; v. raise oneself while hanging from one's hands until one's chin is level with the support bar
translation_zh: n. 下巴, 颏；[医] 颏
example: A strap fastens under the chin to keep the helmet in place.

meaning: n. a sharp sound made by small birds or insects
translation_zh: n. 喳喳声, 唧唧声；v. 吱喳而鸣
example: The chirp was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the person or thing chosen or selected; n. the act of choosing or selecting; s. of superior grade; s. appealing to refined taste
translation_zh: n. 选择, 精选品, 选择权；a. 精选的, 挑三拣四的, 上等的；[计] DOS内部命令:在批处理文件中；该命令用于提示用户作出选择, 决定批处理文件的流程
example: You have to make a choice.

meaning: v. pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives; v. select as an alternative over another; v. see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way
translation_zh: vt. 选择, 宁愿, 欲；vi. 作出选择, 愿意；[计] 选取
example: You can choose any book you like.

meaning: n. one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship; n. a place for public (especially Christian) worship; n. the body of people who attend or belong to a particular local church; v. perform a special church rite or service for
translation_zh: n. 教堂, 礼拜, 教会；vt. 使人接受宗教仪式；a. 教堂的
example: They go to church every Sunday.

meaning: n. finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper; for smoking
translation_zh: n. 香烟, 纸烟
example: There were three cigarette butts in the ashtray.

meaning: classical music
translation_zh: n. 古典乐; 严肃音乐
example: The classical music was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the operator of dry-cleaning establishment; n. someone whose occupation is cleaning
translation_zh: n. 清洁工人, 清洁剂, 干洗商；[化] 滤清器; 除垢器; 洗净剂; 清洁剂
example: The cleaner arrived to tidy the office.

meaning: n. the state of being free of suspicion; v. make a way or path by removing objects; v. remove; v. be debited and credited to the proper bank accounts
translation_zh: a. 清楚的, 明确的, 澄清的；adv. 清晰地；vt. 澄清, 清除障碍；vi. 放晴, 变清澈；n. 空隙；[计] 清除
example: The sky is clear today.

meaning: r. without doubt or question; r. in an easily perceptible manner
translation_zh: adv. 清楚地
example: He spoke clearly so everyone could understand.

meaning: n. an employee who performs clerical work (e.g., keeps records or accounts); v. work as a clerk, as in the legal business
translation_zh: n. 办事员, 职员, 文书；vi. 当店员
example: The hotel clerk checked us in quickly.

meaning: n. depression of a button on a computer mouse; v. make a clicking or ticking sound; v. produce a click; v. become clear or enter one's consciousness or emotions
translation_zh: n. 咔哒声, 啪嗒声；vi. 作咔哒声；vt. 使发咔哒声；[计] 单击
example: Click here to open the link.

meaning: n. an event that involves rising to a higher point (as in altitude or temperature or intensity etc.); n. the act of climbing something; v. go upward with gradual or continuous progress; v. move with difficulty, by grasping
translation_zh: v. 攀登, 上升, 爬；n. 攀登, 爬升
example: We decided to climb the mountain.

meaning: n an event that involves rising to a higher point (as in altitude or temperature or intensity etc.); v go upward with gradual or continuous progress; v move with difficulty, by grasping; v go up or advance; v slope upward; v improve one's social status; v increase in value or to a higher point
translation_zh: a. 攀缘而登的, 上升的；n. 攀登
example: Chris has just taken up climbing.

meaning: n. a group of genetically identical cells or organisms derived from a single cell or individual by some kind of asexual reproduction; v. make multiple identical copies of
translation_zh: n. 无性系；[计] 代用件
example: We need to clone this carefully.

meaning: n. a rude or vulgar fool; n. a person who amuses others by ridiculous behavior; v. act as or like a clown
translation_zh: n. 小丑, 乡下人
example: The clown made all the children laugh with his silly tricks.

meaning: n. a formal association of people with similar interests; n. stout stick that is larger at one end; n. a playing card in the minor suit that has one or more black trefoils on it; v. unite with a common purpose
translation_zh: n. 俱乐部, 木棍, 球棒；vt. 用棍棒打, 缴纳；vi. 联合起来；a. 俱乐部的
example: She joined a book club last year.

meaning: n. evidence that helps to solve a problem; v. roll into a ball
translation_zh: n. 线索, 暗示；vt. 暗示, 提供线索
example: The burglar left no clues.

meaning: n. a slope down which sleds may coast; n. the area within view; v. move effortlessly; by force of gravity
translation_zh: n. 海岸, 滑坡；v. 沿海岸而行
example: We spent our vacation on the coast.

meaning: n. a flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money; v. make up
translation_zh: n. 硬币, 金钱, 货币；vt. 铸币, 创造, 杜撰
example: They flipped a coin to see who should go first.

meaning: n. large genus of African trees bearing kola nuts; n. carbonated drink flavored with extract from kola nuts (`dope' is a southernism in the United States)
translation_zh: 结肠, 冒号, 科朗；[化] 可乐果; 可乐果属; 可乐果干子叶
example: The cola was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a short prayer generally preceding the lesson in the Church of Rome or the Church of England; v. call for and obtain payment of; v. get or bring together; v. gather or collect
translation_zh: v. 收集, 聚集, 集中, 搜集；a. 由收到者付款的；adv. 由收到者付款地
example: He likes to collect stamps from different countries.

meaning: a. having striking color; a. striking in variety and interest
translation_zh: a. 华美的, 富有色彩的, 有趣的
example: The garden was full of colorful flowers.

meaning: a striking in variety and interest; a having striking color
translation_zh: a. 颜色丰富的, 鲜艳的, 艳丽的, 多色的, 丰富多彩的, 吸引人的, 引人入胜的；[计] 有色的
example: The male birds are more colourful than the females.

meaning: n. a line of units following one after another; n. a vertical glass tube used in column chromatography; a mixture is poured in the top and washed through a stationary substance where components of the mixture are adsorbed selectively to form colored bands; n. a vertical array of numbers or other information; n. anything that approximates the shape of a column or tower
translation_zh: n. 专栏, 圆柱, 纵队, 列, 柱形物；[计] 列, 柱形图
example: The website has an attractive two-column format.

meaning: n. a flat device with narrow pointed teeth on one edge; disentangles or arranges hair; n. the fleshy red crest on the head of the domestic fowl and other gallinaceous birds; n. any of several tools for straightening fibers; n. ciliated comb-like swimming plate of a ctenophore
translation_zh: n. 头梳, 鸡冠；vt. 梳头发, 梳毛；vi. (浪)涌起
example: She combs her hair every morning.

meaning: n. light and humorous drama with a happy ending
translation_zh: n. 喜剧, 有趣的事情
example: We watched a funny comedy last night.

meaning: a. providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal); a. free from stress or conducive to mental ease; having or affording peace of mind; s. more than adequate; s. sufficient to provide comfort
translation_zh: a. 舒服的, 轻松的；n. 盖被
example: The sofa is very comfortable.

meaning: a. of or relating to or characteristic of comedy
translation_zh: n. 连环漫画, 喜剧演员, 滑稽的人；a. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜剧的
example: The play is both comic and tragic.

meaning: n. a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material; v. make or write a comment on; v. explain or interpret something
translation_zh: n. 注解, 批评, 评论, 备注；vi. 评论, 注解；[计] 备注
example: She made a positive comment about his work.

meaning: n. the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action; n. an engagement by contract involving financial obligation; n. a message that makes a pledge; n. the official act of consigning a person to confinement (as in a prison or mental hospital)
translation_zh: n. 委托, 交押, 承担义务, 赞助；[医] 院禁
example: I'm not ready to make a long-term commitment.

meaning: a. belonging to or participated in by a community as a whole; public; a. having no special distinction or quality; widely known or commonly encountered; average or ordinary or usual; s. common to or shared by two or more parties; s. commonly encountered
translation_zh: a. 通常的, 共同的, 通俗的, 公共的；[计] 公用块
example: It's common to see tourists here in summer.

meaning: v. transmit information; v. transmit thoughts or feelings; v. join or connect; v. be in verbal contact; interchange information or ideas
translation_zh: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染；vi. 通讯
example: It's important to communicate clearly.

meaning: n. an institution created to conduct business; n. small military unit; usually two or three platoons; n. the state of being with someone; n. organization of performers and associated personnel (especially theatrical)
translation_zh: n. 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群；vt. 陪伴；vi. 交往
example: She works for a big company.

meaning: n. the comparative form of an adjective or adverb; a. relating to or based on or involving comparison
translation_zh: a. 比较的, 相对的；n. 对手
example: Then he was living in comparative comfort (= compared with others or with his own life at a previous time).

meaning: v. express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness; v. make a formal accusation; bring a formal charge
translation_zh: v. 抱怨, 抗议, 控诉
example: She always complains about the weather.

meaning: n. (formerly) a loud cry (or repeated cries) of pain or rage or sorrow; n. an expression of grievance or resentment; n. (civil law) the first pleading of the plaintiff setting out the facts on which the claim for relief is based
translation_zh: n. 诉苦, 抱怨, 控诉；[医] 陈诉; 病
example: She said the police had immediately investigated the complaint.

meaning: n. someone who composes music as a profession
translation_zh: n. 作曲家, 作家, 调停者
example: Verdi was a prolific composer of operas.

meaning: n. a concentrated form of a foodstuff; the bulk is reduced by removing water; n. a concentrated example of something; v. make denser, stronger, or purer; v. direct one's attention on something
translation_zh: n. 浓缩, 精选；v. 集中, 专心
example: We need to concentrate this carefully.

meaning: n. a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging; v. contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement; v. settle by agreement
translation_zh: n. 音乐会, 和声, 一致；vt. 协力, 协调；vi. 协力；[计] 美国北卡罗来纳州Internet网
example: We went to a rock concert last night.

meaning: a. having or marked by confidence or assurance; s. not liable to error in judgment or action
translation_zh: a. 有信心的, 有把握的
example: She was in a relaxed, confident mood.

meaning: v. mistake one thing for another; v. be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly; v. cause to feel embarrassment; v. make unclear, indistinct, or blurred
translation_zh: vt. 使混乱, 使狼狈, 使困惑；[法] 混淆
example: We need to confuse this carefully.

meaning: s. lacking orderly continuity; s. having lost your bearings; confused as to time or place or personal identity; a. mentally confused; unable to think with clarity or act intelligently
translation_zh: a. 困惑的, 混乱的
example: This is a very confused situation.

meaning: v. connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces; v. be or become joined or united or linked; v. join by means of communication equipment; v. land on or hit solidly
translation_zh: v. 连接, 联合, 联系
example: Can you connect these two wires?

meaning: n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon; n. the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual; n. having important effects or influence
translation_zh: n. 结果, 重要性；[法] 结果, 后果, 推断
example: Remember that actions have consequences.

meaning: v. have its essential character; be comprised or contained in; be embodied in; v. be consistent in form, tenor, or character; be congruous; v. be composed of
translation_zh: vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致
example: We need to consist this carefully.

meaning: n. any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)
translation_zh: n. 容器, 集装箱；[化] 集装箱; 贮存箱; 容器(任何一种)
example: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.

meaning: n. one of the large landmasses of the earth; n. the European mainland; a. having control over urination and defecation
translation_zh: n. 大陆, 洲；a. 自制的
example: Africa is the second-largest continent.

meaning: v. continue a certain state, condition, or activity; v. continue talking; v. keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last; v. do something repeatedly and showing no intention to stop
translation_zh: vi. 继续, 延续, 延长；vt. 使继续, 使延长
example: We will continue our discussion tomorrow.

meaning: n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared; n. the act of distinguishing by comparing differences; n. the perceptual effect of the juxtaposition of very different colors; n. the range of optical density and tone on a photographic negative or print (or the extent to which adjacent areas on a television screen differ in brightness)
translation_zh: n. 差别, 对比, 对照物；vt. 使对比；vi. 成对照；[计] 反差; 对比度
example: The two cities make an interesting contrast.

meaning: n. the state of being suitable or opportune; n. the quality of being useful and convenient
translation_zh: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的时候
example: We have provided seats for the convenience of our customers.

meaning: a. suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
translation_zh: a. 方便的, 合宜的；[法] 适当的, 合理而可行的, 方便的
example: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.

meaning: n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
translation_zh: n. 会话, 说话, 交谈；[法] 交谈, 社交, 性交
example: We had a long conversation about our plans.

meaning: n. a utensil for cooking
translation_zh: n. 炊事用具, 炉灶, 锅, 炊具, 烹饪用水果, 窜改者, 伪造者；[化] 蒸锅
example: She bought a new slow cooker for her kitchen.

meaning: n. the act of preparing something (as food) by the application of heat
translation_zh: n. 烹饪；[化] 熬炼; 热炼; 蒸煮
example: My husband does all the cooking.

meaning: n. a refrigerator for cooling liquids; n. an iced drink especially white wine and fruit juice; n. a cell for violent prisoners
translation_zh: n. 冷却器；[化] 冷却器
example: We packed drinks in the cooler for the picnic.

meaning: n. a thing made to be similar or identical to another thing; n. matter to be printed; exclusive of graphical materials; n. material suitable for a journalistic account; v. copy down as is
translation_zh: n. 副本, 摹仿, 一册；v. 复印, 抄袭, 复制；[计] 副本; 复制; DOS内部命令:复制文件；将几个文件合并成一个文件, 以及将文件传至外设或在设备之间传送
example: Can I have a copy of that document?

meaning: v. make right or correct; v. treat a defect; a. free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth; s. socially right or correct
translation_zh: a. 正确的, 合适的；vt. 改正, 订正
example: Your answer is correct.

meaning: r. in an accurate manner
translation_zh: adv. 对, 正确, 恰当, 符合一般性准则, 符合行为准则, 端正, 符合
example: Please spell your name correctly.

meaning: n. the total spent for goods or services including money and time and labor; v. be priced at; v. require to lose, suffer, or sacrifice
translation_zh: n. 代价, 价值, 费用；vi. 花费；vt. 使失去, 值, 使花费
example: What is the cost of this book?

meaning: n. table consisting of a horizontal surface over which business is transacted; n. game equipment (as a piece of wood, plastic, or ivory) used for keeping a count or reserving a space in various card or board games; n. a calculator that keeps a record of the number of times something happens; n. a person who counts things
translation_zh: n. 计算器, 计算者, 柜台, 筹码；a. 反方向的, 相反的；adv. 反方向地, 相反地；[计] 计数器; 计数字
example: Please place your order at the counter.

meaning: n. the territory occupied by a nation; n. an area outside of cities and towns
translation_zh: n. 国家, 乡村, 地区, 故乡；a. 乡下的, 农村的；[计] DOS外部命令:用于设定国家代码, 包括日期时间及货币格式
example: Which country are you from?

meaning: n. rural regions
translation_zh: n. 乡下地方, 乡下居民
example: We enjoyed a walk in the beautiful countryside.

meaning: n. a pair who associate with one another; n. a pair of people who live together; n. a small indefinite number; n. two items of the same kind
translation_zh: n. 对, 夫妇, 数个；vt. 使成双, 连接, 使成婚, 把...联系起来；vi. 结合, 成婚
example: A young couple walked hand in hand.

meaning: n. education imparted in a series of lessons or meetings; n. a connected series of events or actions or developments; n. general line of orientation; n. a mode of action
translation_zh: n. 课程, 路线, 过程, 一道菜, 道路；v. 追, (使)跑
example: I'm taking a history course.

meaning: n. the act of concealing the existence of something by obstructing the view of it; n. fire that makes it difficult for the enemy to fire on your own individuals or formations; n. a recording of a song that was first recorded or made popular by somebody else; n. a false identity and background (especially one created for an undercover agent)
translation_zh: n. 盖子, 封面, 藉口；vt. 覆盖, 掩饰, 保护, 掩护, 包括；vi. 覆盖
example: The book has a beautiful cover.

meaning: n. someone deranged and possibly dangerous; s. foolish; totally unsound; s. possessed by inordinate excitement; s. bizarre or fantastic
translation_zh: a. 发狂的, 狂热的
example: That's a crazy idea, but it might work!

meaning: n. the best people or things in a group; n. the part of milk containing the butterfat; n. toiletry consisting of any of various substances in the form of a thick liquid that have a soothing and moisturizing effect when applied to the skin; v. make creamy by beating
translation_zh: n. 乳酪, 奶油, 面霜；[医] 乳油, 乳皮; 乳膏, 霜
example: Would you like cream in your coffee?

meaning: n. the ability to create
translation_zh: n. 创造力, 创造性
example: The creativity was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a human being; `wight' is an archaic term; n. a person who is controlled by others and is used to perform unpleasant or dishonest tasks for someone else
translation_zh: n. 人, 动物, 创造物, 生物
example: The forest is home to many strange creatures.

meaning: n. leaping insect; male makes chirping noises by rubbing the forewings together; n. a game played with a ball and bat by two teams of 11 players; teams take turns trying to score runs; v. play cricket
translation_zh: n. 蟋蟀, 板球
example: We heard a cricket chirping outside.

meaning: s. (of something seen or heard) clearly defined; s. tender and brittle; s. pleasantly cold and invigorating; s. pleasingly firm and fresh
translation_zh: a. 脆的, 新鲜的, 活泼的；v. (使)烘脆, (使)拳曲, (使)起皱；n. 松脆物
example: Bake until the pastry is golden and crisp.

meaning: v find fault with; express criticism of; point out real or perceived flaws; v act as a critic
translation_zh: v. 批评, 吹毛求疵, 非难
example: We need to criticise this carefully.

meaning: v. act as a critic
translation_zh: v. 批评, 吹毛求疵, 非难
example: We need to criticize this carefully.

meaning: n. a wooden structure consisting of an upright post with a transverse piece; n. a representation of the structure on which Jesus was crucified; used as an emblem of Christianity or in heraldry; n. any affliction that causes great suffering; v. fold so as to resemble a cross
translation_zh: n. 十字架, 十字架形物件, 交叉, 十字标, 交叉路, 磨难, 杂交；a. 生气的, 交叉的, 相反的；v. 交叉, 横过, 越过；[计] 交叉, 十字标
example: He drew a cross on the paper.

meaning: n. a large number of things or people considered together; n. an informal body of friends; v. fill or occupy to the point of overflowing; v. to gather together in large numbers
translation_zh: n. 群众, 一伙人；vt. 拥挤, 挤满, 挤进
example: A large crowd gathered in the square.

meaning: a. overfilled or compacted or concentrated
translation_zh: a. 拥挤的, 塞满的
example: We made our way through the crowded streets.

meaning: n. the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy; n. the part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel; n. a wreath or garland worn on the head to signify victory; n. an ornamental jeweled headdress signifying sovereignty
translation_zh: n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点；vt. 使成王, 加冕, 居...之顶
example: The queen wore a beautiful crown.

meaning: n. an ocean trip taken for pleasure; v. drive around aimlessly but ostentatiously and at leisure; v. travel at a moderate speed; v. look for a sexual partner in a public place
translation_zh: n. 巡航, 巡弋, 漫游；v. 巡航, 巡弋, 漫游
example: I'd love to go on a round-the-world cruise.

meaning: n. a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition; n. a loud utterance of emotion (especially when inarticulate); n. a fit of weeping; n. the characteristic utterance of an animal
translation_zh: n. 叫声, 哭声, 大叫；vi. 哭, 叫, 喊；vt. 叫喊, 大声说, 哭出
example: The baby started to cry.

meaning: n. a small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space
translation_zh: n. 食橱, 碗柜, 餐具柜
example: There's plenty of food in the cupboards.

meaning: n. (East Indian cookery) a pungent dish of vegetables or meats flavored with curry powder and usually eaten with rice; v. season with a mixture of spices; typical of Indian cooking; v. treat by incorporating fat
translation_zh: n. 咖哩粉, 咖哩饭菜；vt. 用咖哩粉调味, 用马梳梳, 制革
example: I love to eat chicken curry with rice.

meaning: n. profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger; n. a severe affliction; v. utter obscenities or profanities; v. heap obscenities upon
translation_zh: n. 咒骂, 诅咒；vt. 诅咒, 咒骂
example: He muttered a curse at the other driver.

meaning: n. accepted or habitual practice; n. a specific practice of long standing; n. habitual patronage
translation_zh: n. 习惯, 风俗, 海关, 自定义；a. 定制的；[计] 定制; 自定义
example: It's a local custom.

meaning: n. someone who pays for goods or services
translation_zh: n. 消费者；[化] 顾客
example: The customer bought a new phone.

meaning: s. obviously contrived to charm
translation_zh: a. 可爱的, 聪明的, 伶俐的；[医] 品他病
example: The puppy is very cute.

meaning: n. the sport of traveling on a bicycle or motorcycle
translation_zh: n. 骑脚踏车兜风, 骑脚踏车消遣；[机] 循环操作
example: Cycling is Europe's second most popular sport.

meaning: n. a newspaper that is published every day; s. of or belonging to or occurring every day; r. every day; without missing a day
translation_zh: a. 每日的, 日常的；adv. 每日地, 日常地；n. 日报
example: I read the daily newspaper.

meaning: n. a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea; n. female parent of an animal especially domestic livestock; v. obstruct with, or as if with, a dam
translation_zh: n. 水坝, 障碍；v. 控制, 筑坝；[计] 直接存取法
example: The dam burst.

meaning: n. a performer who dances professionally; n. a person who participates in a social gathering arranged for dancing (as a ball)
translation_zh: n. 舞蹈演员, 跳舞者
example: She is a talented ballet dancer.

meaning: n. the condition of being susceptible to harm or injury; n. a cause of pain or injury or loss; n. a dangerous place
translation_zh: n. 危险, 威胁；[法] 危险, 危险物, 危机
example: You are in danger if you go there alone.

meaning: a. involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm; s. causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
translation_zh: a. 危险的；[法] 危险的, 危害的
example: It's dangerous to walk alone at night.

meaning: n. the specified day of the month; n. a participant in a date; n. a meeting arranged in advance; n. a particular but unspecified point in time
translation_zh: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树；vt. 约会, 定日期；vi. 注明日期, 过时
example: What is today's date?

meaning: n. light during the daytime
translation_zh: n. 白昼, 日光；vt. 使沐浴于日光；vi. 享有日光
example: We need to finish before daylight fades.

meaning: n. people who are no longer living; n. a time when coldness (or some other quality associated with death) is intense; a. no longer having or seeming to have or expecting to have life; a. not showing characteristics of life especially the capacity to sustain life; no longer exerting force or having energy or heat
translation_zh: a. 死的, 不活泼的, 麻木的, 熄灭的；n. 死者；adv. 完全地, 直接地
example: The plant is dead because I forgot to water it.

meaning: s. with or in a close or intimate relationship; s. earnest
translation_zh: n. 亲爱的人；a. 亲爱的, 昂贵的, 严重的, 急迫的；interj. 啊；adv. 深爱地, 高价地
example: My dear friend, how are you?

meaning: v. reach, make, or come to a decision about something; v. bring to an end; settle conclusively; v. cause to decide; v. influence or determine
translation_zh: v. 决定, 判决
example: I need to decide what to do next.

meaning: n. the act of making up your mind about something; n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration; n. (boxing) a victory won on points when no knockout has occurred; n. the outcome of a game or contest
translation_zh: n. 决定, 决心, 决断；[计] 判定
example: That was a difficult decision.

meaning: n. the central and most intense or profound part; n. literary term for an ocean; a. relatively deep or strong; affecting one deeply; s. marked by depth of thinking
translation_zh: a. 深的；adv. 深入地；n. 深渊, 深处
example: The lake is very deep in the middle.

meaning: r. to a great depth; far down
translation_zh: adv. 深刻地, 在深处, 深沉地
example: She spoke deeply during the meeting.

meaning: n. time during which some action is awaited; n. the act of delaying; inactivity resulting in something being put off until a later time; v. cause to be slowed down or delayed; v. act later than planned, scheduled, or required
translation_zh: n. 耽搁, 迟滞；v. 耽搁, 延迟；[计] 延迟, 延时
example: Commuters will face long delays on the roads today.

meaning: n. a person qualified to practice dentistry
translation_zh: n. 牙科医生；[医] 牙医师
example: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.

meaning: department store
translation_zh: 百货公司；[经] 百货商店
example: She took a job as a sales assistant in the lingerie section of a department store.

meaning: v. be contingent upon (something that is elided)
translation_zh: vi. 靠, 视...而定, 信赖
example: Our picnic depends on the weather.

meaning: n. arid land with little or no vegetation; v. leave behind
translation_zh: n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳；a. 沙漠的, 不毛的；vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离；vi. 逃掉
example: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.

meaning: n. a dish served as the last course of a meal
translation_zh: n. 餐后甜点
example: For dessert, we had apple pie with ice cream.

meaning: a. being changed over time so as to be e.g. stronger or more complete or more useful; s. (used of societies) having high industrial development; s. (of real estate) made more useful and profitable as by building or laying out roads
translation_zh: a. 发达的（国家或地区）；成熟的
example: This is a very developed situation.

meaning: n. a transparent piece of diamond that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem; n. very hard native crystalline carbon valued as a gem; n. a playing card in the minor suit that has one or more red rhombuses on it
translation_zh: n. 钻石, 菱形；[计] 菱形
example: She was wearing her diamonds (= jewellery with diamonds in it).

meaning: n. a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations; n. a personal journal (as a physical object)
translation_zh: n. 日记；[经] 日记簿
example: She wrote her thoughts in her diary every night.

meaning: n. a small cube with 1 to 6 spots on the six faces; used in gambling to generate random numbers; n. a device used for shaping metal; n. a cutting tool that is fitted into a diestock and used for cutting male (external) screw threads on screws or bolts or pipes or rods; v. pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
