translation_zh: vi. 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄灭, 漠然, 渴望；vt. 死；n. 骰子, 冲模
example: Many plants die in winter.

meaning: n. the quality of being unlike or dissimilar; n. a significant change
translation_zh: n. 不同, 差异；[计] 差分
example: What is the difference between these two shirts?

meaning: a. unlike in nature or quality or form or degree; s. distinctly separate from the first; s. differing from all others; not ordinary; s. distinct or separate
translation_zh: a. 不同的；[机] 差动, 微分的, 差速器
example: These two shirts are very different.

meaning: r. in another and different manner;
translation_zh: adv. 差异, 不同, 各别, 各种
example: Try to do it differently this time.

meaning: n. a factor causing trouble in achieving a positive result or tending to produce a negative result; n. a condition or state of affairs almost beyond one's ability to deal with and requiring great effort to bear or overcome; n. the quality of being difficult
translation_zh: n. 困难, 难点
example: She faced many difficulties in her new job.

meaning: digital camera
translation_zh: n. 数码相机
example: The digital camera was important for everyone.

meaning: n. any of numerous extinct terrestrial reptiles of the Mesozoic era
translation_zh: n. 恐龙
example: Many children are fascinated by dinosaurs.

meaning: n. a line leading to a place or point; n. the spatial relation between something and the course along which it points or moves; n. a general course along which something has a tendency to develop; n. a message describing how something is to be done
translation_zh: n. 方向, 指导, 趋势；[计] 方向; 流向
example: Which direction should we go?

meaning: n. the quality of having an inferior or less favorable position; v. put at a disadvantage; hinder, harm
translation_zh: n. 缺点, 不利, 坏处
example: Some pension plans may disadvantage women.

meaning: v. be of different opinions; v. be different from one another
translation_zh: vi. 不一致, 不适宜；[法] 抵触, 不同意, 争执
example: I disagree with your point of view.

meaning: v. get lost, as without warning or explanation
translation_zh: vi. 消失, 不见
example: The magician made the rabbit disappear.

meaning: v fail to meet the hopes or expectations of; s disappointingly unsuccessful
translation_zh: a. 失望的
example: This is a very disappointed situation.

meaning: s. not up to expectations
translation_zh: a. 使失望的, 期待落空的, 令人沮丧的
example: The team has had a disappointing start to the season.

meaning: n. popular dance music (especially in the late 1970s); melodic with a regular bass beat; intended mainly for dancing at discotheques; n. a public dance hall for dancing to recorded popular music; v. dance to disco music
translation_zh: n. 夜总会, 迪斯科, 的士高
example: The DJ played everything from disco to hip-hop.

meaning: v. make a discovery, make a new finding; v. make a discovery; v. see for the first time; make a discovery
translation_zh: vt. 发现, 找到, 暴露；vi. 发现
example: They hope to discover a cure for the disease.

meaning: a. deceptive or fraudulent; disposed to cheat or defraud or deceive
translation_zh: a. 不诚实的；[法] 不忠实的, 不诚实的, 欺诈的
example: Beware of dishonest traders in the tourist areas.

meaning: n. a feeling of aversion or antipathy; v. have or feel a dislike or distaste for
translation_zh: n. 嫌恶；vt. 讨厌, 不喜欢
example: She disliked her boss intensely.

meaning: n. the property created by the space between two objects or points; n. a distant region; n. size of the gap between two places; n. indifference by personal withdrawal
translation_zh: n. 距离, 远方, 遥远；[计] 位距
example: The distance to the city center is about 5 miles.

meaning: v. move deeply; v. damage as if by shaking or jarring
translation_zh: vt. 扰乱, 妨碍, 使不安；[法] 滋扰, 扰乱
example: We need to disturb this carefully.

meaning: v. make dizzy or giddy; s. having or causing a whirling sensation; liable to falling
translation_zh: a. 晕眩的, 眼花缭乱的；vt. 使晕眩
example: Climbing so high made me feel dizzy.

meaning: s. having finished or arrived at completion; s. cooked until ready to serve
translation_zh: a. 完成了的, 好了的；do的过去分词
example: The done was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a base hit on which the batter stops safely at second base; n. a stand-in for movie stars to perform dangerous stunts; n. someone who closely resembles a famous person (especially an actor); n. a quantity that is twice as great as another
translation_zh: n. 两倍；a. 两倍的, 双重的；vt. 使加倍；vi. 加倍, 代替, 快步走；[计] 双精度型
example: I ordered a double espresso.

meaning: a. of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center; r. toward or in the lower or central part of town
translation_zh: n. 市中心区；a. 市中心的；adv. 往闹市区
example: Let's go downtown for dinner tonight.

meaning: n. a gully that is shallower than a ravine; n. the finish of a contest in which the score is tied and the winner is undecided; n. anything (straws or pebbles etc.) taken or chosen at random; n. a playing card or cards dealt or taken from the pack
translation_zh: vi. 拉, 拖, 拔剑；vt. 拖拉, 挨近, 领取, 打成平局, 引导, 抽签决定, 画, 描写, 制订, 草拟, 吸引；n. 拉, 拖, 拔出, 抽签, 平局；[计] 翻牌, 绘图
example: Can you draw a picture of a house?

meaning: n. a boxlike container in a piece of furniture; made so as to slide in and out; n. the person who writes a check or draft instructing the drawee to pay someone else
translation_zh: n. 抽屉, 开票人；[计] 抽屉
example: I keep my socks in the top drawer.

meaning: n. an illustration that is drawn by hand and published in a book, magazine, or newspaper; n. a representation of forms or objects on a surface by means of lines; n. the creation of artistic pictures or diagrams; n. act of getting or draining something such as electricity or a liquid from a source
translation_zh: n. 图画, 制图, 拉；[计] 绘图
example: She showed me a beautiful drawing of a landscape.

meaning: n. a series of mental images and emotions occurring during sleep; n. imaginative thoughts indulged in while awake; n. a state of mind characterized by abstraction and release from reality; n. someone or something wonderful
translation_zh: n. 梦, 空想, 愿望；v. 做梦, 想象, 梦想
example: I had a strange dream last night.

meaning: n. a one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice; v. put on clothes; v. provide with clothes or put clothes on; v. put a finish on
translation_zh: n. 服装, 覆盖物；vi. 穿着；vt. 给...穿衣, 整理
example: She wore a beautiful blue dress to the party.

meaning: s. treated with medications and protective covering; s. (of lumber or stone) to trim and smooth; s. dressed in fancy or formal clothing
translation_zh: a. 穿好衣服的；打扮好的；去内脏及分割加工好的（特指动物, 如鱼, 禽类等）
example: This is a very dressed situation.

meaning: n. a tool with a sharp point and cutting edges for making holes in hard materials (usually rotating rapidly or by repeated blows); n. similar to the mandrill but smaller and less brightly colored; n. (military) the training of soldiers to march (as in ceremonial parades) or to perform the manual of arms; v. train in the military, e.g., in the use of weapons
translation_zh: n. 钻孔机, 钻子, 播种机, 粗斜纹布；v. 训练, 钻孔
example: This is not a drill! Please evacuate the building.

meaning: n. the act of applying force to propel something; n. a mechanism by which force or power is transmitted in a machine; n. the trait of being highly motivated; n. hitting a golf ball off of a tee with a driver
translation_zh: n. 驾车, 快车道, 推进力, 驱动, 动力, 击球, 驱动器；vt. 开车, 驱使, 推动, 驾驶；vi. 开车, 猛击, 飞跑；[计] 驱动器
example: It's a long drive to the coast.

meaning: n. the operator of a motor vehicle; n. someone who drives animals that pull a vehicle; n. a golfer who hits the golf ball with a driver; n. (computer science) a program that determines how a computer will communicate with a peripheral device
translation_zh: n. 驾驶员, 驱动器, 驱动程序；[化] 驱动器
example: The bus driver was very friendly.

meaning: an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles
translation_zh: n. 驾驶执照，驾照
example: The driver's license was important for everyone.

meaning: driving licence
translation_zh: n. 驾驶执照
example: The driving licence was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a shape that is spherical and small; n. a small indefinite quantity (especially of a liquid); n. a sudden sharp decrease in some quantity; n. a predetermined hiding place for the deposit and distribution of illicit goods (such as drugs or stolen property)
translation_zh: n. 滴, 微量, 落下, 空投；vi. 放下, 掉下, 下降；vt. 使滴下, 放下, 丢失, 遗漏；[计] 投入, 投入点, 接入点, 分接点
example: Be careful not to drop the glass.

meaning: n. a retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold
translation_zh: n. 药房, 杂货店
example: I need to go to the drugstore to pick up my prescription.

meaning: n. a reformer who opposes the use of intoxicating beverages; v. remove the moisture from and make dry; v. become dry or drier; a. free from liquid or moisture; lacking natural or normal moisture or depleted of water; or no longer wet
translation_zh: a. 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的；vt. 把...弄干；vi. 变干；n. 干, 干涸
example: The clothes are dry now.

meaning: n. small wild or domesticated web-footed broad-billed swimming bird usually having a depressed body and short legs; n. (cricket) a score of nothing by a batsman; n. flesh of a duck (domestic or wild); n. a heavy cotton fabric of plain weave; used for clothing and tents
translation_zh: n. 鸭子；vi. 没入水中, 闪避；vt. 猛按...入水, 躲避
example: Every afternoon they went to the park to feed the ducks.

meaning: prep. In the time of; as long as the action or existence of;; as, during life; during the space of a year.
translation_zh: prep. 在...的时候
example: There are extra flights to Colorado during the winter.

meaning: n. fine powdery material such as dry earth or pollen that can be blown about in the air; n. free microscopic particles of solid material; v. remove the dust from; v. rub the dust over a surface so as to blur the outlines of a shape
translation_zh: n. 灰尘, 尘埃, 粉末, 花粉, 土, 骚乱；vt. 拂去灰尘, 撒, 弄成粉末；vi. 拂去灰尘, 化为粉末
example: The old books were covered in dust.

meaning: a. at or near the beginning of a period of time or course of events or before the usual or expected time; a. being or occurring at an early stage of development; s. belonging to the distant past; s. very young
translation_zh: a. 早的, 早熟的；adv. 很早, 初
example: We arrived early.

meaning: n. a list of divisions (chapters or articles) and the pages on which they start
translation_zh: n. 目录；[计] 目录
example: The contents plays an important role.

meaning: v. acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
translation_zh: vt. 赚得, 获得, 博得；[计] 欧州科学研究网
example: He works hard to earn a living.

meaning: v perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight; v perceive (an idea or situation) mentally; v perceive or be contemporaneous with; v imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind; v deem to be; v get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally; v see or watch; v come together; v find out, learn, or determine with certainty, usually by making an inquiry or other effort; v be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something; v go to see for professional or business reasons; v go to see for a social visit; v go to see a place, as for entertainment; v take charge of or deal with; v receive as a specified guest; v date regularly; have a steady relationship with; v see and understand, have a good eye; v deliberate or decide; v observe as if with an eye; v observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect; v go or live through; v accompany or escort; v match or meet; v make sense of; assign a meaning to
translation_zh: see的过去分词
example: The seen plays an important role.

meaning: n. jewelry to ornament the ear; usually clipped to the earlobe or fastened through a hole in the lobe
translation_zh: n. 耳环, 耳饰
example: She lost one of her favorite earrings.

meaning: n a person who participates in or is skilled at some game; n someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession); n a theatrical performer; n a person who pursues a number of different social and sexual partners simultaneously; n an important participant (as in a business deal)
translation_zh: n. 队员, 参与者；迷你音碟机, 雷射唱盘（player的复数形式）；玩家（player的复数形式）
example: The players plays an important role.

meaning: n. the 3rd planet from the sun; the planet we live on; n. the loose soft material that makes up a large part of the land surface; n. the abode of mortals (as contrasted with Heaven or Hell); n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles)
translation_zh: n. 地球, 泥土, 世界, 尘世；vt. 埋入土中, 赶入洞内；vi. 躲入洞内
example: The Earth revolves around the sun.

meaning: n. shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity; n. a disturbance that is extremely disruptive
translation_zh: n. 地震
example: The earthquake measured 68 on the Richter scale.

meaning: r. with ease (`easy' is sometimes used informally for `easily'); r. without question
translation_zh: adv. 容易地, 轻易地, 流利地
example: She can easily lift that box.

meaning: n. the cardinal compass point that is at 90 degrees; n. the countries of Asia; n. the region of the United States lying to the north of the Ohio River and to the east of the Mississippi River; n. the direction corresponding to the eastward cardinal compass point
translation_zh: n. 东方, 东；a. 东方的, 向东的；adv. 向东方, 朝东方
example: The sun rises in the east.

meaning: n. the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill; n. knowledge acquired by learning and instruction; n. the gradual process of acquiring knowledge; n. the profession of teaching (especially at a school or college or university)
translation_zh: n. 教育, 训练, 教育学；[医] 教育, 训练
example: Education is important for everyone.

meaning: r. after a negative statement used as an intensive meaning something like `likewise' or `also'
translation_zh: a. (两者之中)任一的, (两者之中)各一的；pron. (两者之中)任一；conj. 或, 要么
example: She spoke either during the meeting.

meaning: n an amount of something available for use; n offering goods and services for sale; n the activity of supplying or providing something; v give something useful or necessary to; v circulate or distribute or equip with; v give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance; v state or say further
translation_zh: n. 供应品, 日用必需品, 生活用品, (储备)物质, 存货, 补给品, 生活费用；[化] 辅助材料
example: The supplies plays an important role.

meaning: n people who are old collectively; s advanced in years; (`aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
translation_zh: a. 过了中年的, 稍老的
example: She is very busy caring for two elderly relatives.

meaning: imp. & p. p. of Start
translation_zh: v. 出发, 启程( start的过去式和过去分词 ); 起动; 提出（问题）; 开办
example: We must started this carefully.

meaning: n. a car that is powered by electricity; a. using or providing or producing or transmitting or operated by electricity; s. (of a situation) exceptionally tense; s. affected by emotion as if by electricity; thrilling
translation_zh: a. 电的, 导电的, 电动的；[医] 电的
example: We bought an electric car.

meaning: n. five-toed pachyderm; n. the symbol of the Republican Party; introduced in cartoons by Thomas Nast in 1874
translation_zh: n. 象
example: The elephant in the room was the money that had to be paid in bribes.

meaning: n. lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building; n. the airfoil on the tailplane of an aircraft that makes it ascend or descend
translation_zh: n. 电梯, 升降机；[化] 提升机
example: Let's take the elevator to the tenth floor.

meaning: a. & pron. Other; one or something beside; as, Who else is; coming? What else shall I give? Do you expect anything else?; adv. & conj. Besides; except that mentioned; in addition; as,; nowhere else; no one else.; adv. & conj. Otherwise; in the other, or the contrary, case; if; the facts were different.
translation_zh: a. 别的, 其他的；adv. 另外, 否则, 不然
example: What else do you need?

meaning: n a way of regarding situations or topics etc.; n the visual percept of a region; n the act of looking or seeing or observing; n the range of the eye; n a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty; n a message expressing a belief about something; the expression of a belief that is held with confidence but not substantiated by positive knowledge or proof; n purpose; the phrase `with a view to' means `with the intention of' or `for the purpose of'; n graphic art consisting of the graphic or photographic representation of a visual percept; n the range of interest or activity that can be anticipated; n outward appearance; v deem to be; v look at carefully; study mentally; v see or watch
translation_zh: n. 景点；见解；查看；视图（view的复数）
example: The views plays an important role.

meaning: r. in or to another place
translation_zh: adv. 在别处
example: She spoke elsewhere during the meeting.

meaning: n a series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished; n an arrangement scheme; n scale drawing of a structure; v have the will and intention to carry out some action; v make plans for something; v make or work out a plan for; devise; v make a design of; plan out in systematic, often graphic form
translation_zh: n. 计划；规划（plan的复数）
example: The plans plays an important role.

meaning: n (computer science) a system of world-wide electronic communication in which a computer user can compose a message at one terminal that can be regenerated at the recipient's terminal when the recipient logs in; v communicate electronically on the computer
translation_zh: n. 电子信函
example: I sent him an email this morning.

meaning: s. causing to feel shame or chagrin or vexation
translation_zh: a. 令人为难的, 麻烦的
example: This is a very embarrassing situation.

meaning: n. a worker who is hired to perform a job
translation_zh: n. 职员, 员工, 受雇人员；[化] 职工; 雇员
example: Every employee receives a bonus at the end of the year.

meaning: n. a container that has been emptied; v. make void or empty of contents; v. become empty or void of its content; v. remove
translation_zh: a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的；n. 空的东西, 空车；vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出；vi. 流空；[计] 空
example: The box was empty.

meaning: v. inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to; v. spur on
translation_zh: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励；[法] 怂恿, 煽动, 助长
example: We need to encourage this carefully.

meaning: n. either extremity of something that has length; n. the point in time at which something ends; n. the concluding parts of an event or occurrence; n. a final part or section
translation_zh: n. 结束, 终点, 目标, 末端, 梢, 死亡, 残余；v. 结束, 终结, 终止；[计] 端; 结束
example: This is the end of the movie.

meaning: n a subdivision of a particular kind of thing; n a person of a specified kind (usually with many eccentricities); n (biology) the taxonomic group whose characteristics are used to define the next higher taxon; n printed characters; n all of the tokens of the same symbol; n a small metal block bearing a raised character on one end; produces a printed character when inked and pressed on paper; v write by means of a keyboard with types; v identify as belonging to a certain type
translation_zh: v. 打字（type的第三人称单数形式）
example: The types plays an important role.

meaning: s. (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
translation_zh: a. 有生命危险的；濒临灭绝的
example: The sea turtle is an endangered species .

meaning: n. the end of a word (a suffix or inflectional ending or final morpheme); n. event whose occurrence ends something
translation_zh: n. 终止, 终了, 收场；[医] 末梢
example: The movie had a surprising ending.

meaning: v assume sponsorship of; v assume responsibility for or leadership of; v do one's shopping at; do business with; be a customer or client of
translation_zh: v. 赞助( sponsor的过去式和过去分词); 资助（某人的培训或教育）; 为慈善活动捐资; 发起, 倡议；a. 赞助的; 发起的
example: We must sponsored this carefully.

meaning: a. possessing or exerting or displaying energy; s. working hard to promote an enterprise
translation_zh: a. 精力充沛的, 积极的
example: He knew I was energetic and dynamic and would get things done.

meaning: n a formation of people or things one beside another; n a mark that is long relative to its width; n a formation of people or things one behind another; n a length (straight or curved) without breadth or thickness; the trace of a moving point; n text consisting of a row of words written across a page or computer screen; n a single frequency (or very narrow band) of radiation in a spectrum; n a fortified position (especially one marking the most forward position of troops); n a course of reasoning aimed at demonstrating a truth or falsehood; the methodical process of logical reasoning; n a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power; n a connected series of events or actions or developments; n a spatial location defined by a real or imaginary unidimensional extent; n a slight depression in the smoothness of a surface; n a pipe used to transport liquids or gases; n the road consisting of railroad track and roadbed; n a telephone connection; n acting in conformity; n the descendants of one individual; n something (as a cord or rope) that is long and thin and flexible; n the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money; n in games or sports; a mark indicating positions or bounds of the playing area; n (often plural) a means of communication or access; n a particular kind of product or merchandise; n a commercial organization serving as a common carrier; n space for one line of print (one column wide and 1/14 inch deep) used to measure advertising; n the maximum credit that a customer is allowed; n a succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence; n persuasive but insincere talk that is usually intended to deceive or impress; n a short personal letter; n a conceptual separation or distinction; n mechanical system in a factory whereby an article is conveyed through sites at which successive operations are performed on it; v be in line with; form a line along; v cover the interior of; v make a mark or lines on a surface; v mark with lines; v fill plentifully; v reinforce with fabric
translation_zh: n. 台词
example: The lines plays an important role.

meaning: s. extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman
translation_zh: a. 巨大的, 庞大的
example: Current processors can perform an enormous number of operations per second.

meaning: n. an adequate quantity; a quantity that is large enough to achieve a purpose; r. as much as necessary; (`plenty' is nonstandard) "I've had plenty, thanks"
translation_zh: n. 充足, 够, 很多；a. 充足的, 足够；adv. 足够；interj. 够了
example: Do we have enough time?

meaning: v. to come or go into; v. become a participant; be involved in; v. come on stage
translation_zh: vt. 进入, 参加, 开始, 输入, 回车；vi. 进去, 参加；[计] 输入, 回车
example: Please enter the room quietly.

meaning: n. something that provides access (to get in or get out); n. a movement into or inward; n. the act of entering; v. put into a trance
translation_zh: n. 入口, 进入点, 入场, 入学, 进入, 开始(阶段), 就任；vt. 使出神, 使入迷；[计] 入口
example: The main entrance is on the left.

meaning: n financial assistance in time of need; n something that aids or promotes well-being; n a performance to raise money for a charitable cause; v derive a benefit from; v be beneficial for
translation_zh: n. 利益, 收益；福利, 效益（benefit的复数形式）
example: The benefits plays an important role.

meaning: n. a flat (usually rectangular) container for a letter, thin package, etc.; n. any wrapper or covering; n. a curve that is tangent to each of a family of curves; n. a natural covering (as by a fluid)
translation_zh: n. 信封, 封套, 封袋；[医] 膜, 包袋
example: I put the letter in an envelope.

meaning: s. necessary for relief or supply
translation_zh: a. 需要的
example: We must needed this carefully.

meaning: n. the totality of surrounding conditions; n. the area in which something exists or lives
translation_zh: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕；[计] 环境
example: We should protect our natural environment.

meaning: n. a feeling of grudging admiration and desire to have something that is possessed by another; n. spite and resentment at seeing the success of another (personified as one of the deadly sins); v. feel envious towards; admire enviously; v. be envious of; set one's heart on
translation_zh: n. 羡慕, 嫉妒；vt. 羡慕, 嫉妒
example: He couldn't conceal his envy of me.

meaning: n. an instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service
translation_zh: n. 装备, 设备, 才能；[化] 设备; 装备; 装置
example: We need to buy new equipment for the gym.

meaning: n. a misconception resulting from incorrect information; n. (baseball) a failure of a defensive player to make an out when normal play would have sufficed; n. departure from what is ethically acceptable; n. (computer science) the occurrence of an incorrect result produced by a computer
translation_zh: n. 错误, 过失, 失误, 误差；[计] 错误
example: There was an error in the calculation.

meaning: a. occupied or in the control of; often used in combination
translation_zh: hold的过去式和过去分词
example: The held plays an important role.

meaning: n. a stairway whose steps move continuously on a circulating belt
translation_zh: n. 电动扶梯, 自动扶梯；[机] 升降阶梯
example: We took the escalator to the second floor of the department store.

meaning: n a Mid-Atlantic state; one of the original 13 colonies
translation_zh: 纽约；[经] 纽约
example: The ny plays an important role.

meaning: n. an analytic or interpretive literary composition; n. a tentative attempt
translation_zh: n. 随笔, 短文, 评论, 企图；vt. 试图
example: I have to write an essay this weekend.

meaning: n. the basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union (introduced in 1999); in 2002 twelve European nations (Germany, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Ireland, Greece, Austria, Finland) adopted the euro as their basic unit of money and abandoned their traditional currencies
translation_zh: n. 欧元（欧盟的统一货币单位）
example: How many euros do you have?

meaning: n. a native or inhabitant of Europe; a. of or relating to or characteristic of Europe or the people of Europe
translation_zh: n. 欧洲人；a. 欧洲的, 欧洲人的
example: She is a European citizen.

meaning: n. something that happens at a given place and time; n. a special set of circumstances; n. a phenomenon located at a single point in space-time; the fundamental observational entity in relativity theory
translation_zh: n. 事件, 结果, 事情的进程, 竞赛项目；[计] 事件
example: The concert was a major event.

meaning: r. at any time; r. (intensifier for adjectives) very
translation_zh: adv. 曾经, 究竟, 永远
example: Have you ever been to Paris.

meaning: r. to or in any or all places; (`everyplace' is used informally for `everywhere')
translation_zh: adv. 各处, 到处
example: I looked everywhere for my keys.

meaning: r indicating exactness or preciseness; r just as it should be; r in a precise manner
translation_zh: adv. 确切地, 精确地, 恰好, 完全地, 确实, 恰恰正是, 确实如此
example: That's exactly what I meant.

meaning: n a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
translation_zh: n. 考试, 测验
example: I have a math exam tomorrow.

meaning: v inquire about; v make a request or demand for something to somebody; v direct or put; seek an answer to; v consider obligatory; request and expect; v address a question to and expect an answer from; v require as useful, just, or proper; v require or ask for as a price or condition
translation_zh: n. 卖方要价
example: We must asked this carefully.

meaning: n. an item of information that is typical of a class or group; n. punishment intended as a warning to others
translation_zh: n. 例子, 样本, 实例；[化] 实例
example: Can you give me an example?

meaning: eur
translation_zh: n. 欧洲, 欧洲人；欧元
example: The eur plays an important role.

meaning: s. very good; of the highest quality
translation_zh: a. 优良的, 杰出的, 出色的
example: That was an excellent meal.

meaning: v take exception to; v prevent from being included or considered or accepted
translation_zh: vt. 除, 除外；vi. 反对；prep. 除了...之外, 若不是, 除非；conj. 只是
example: We work every day except Sunday.

meaning: v. arouse or elicit a feeling; v. raise to a higher energy level; v. produce a magnetic field in
translation_zh: vt. 刺激, 使兴奋, 激励
example: The news excited everyone.

meaning: a. creating or arousing excitement; s. stimulating interest and discussion
translation_zh: a. 令人兴奋的, 刺激的；[电] 激磁
example: It was an exciting game.

meaning: n. a public building for gambling and entertainment; n. a card game in which cards face up on the table are taken with eligible cards in the hand
translation_zh: n. 卡西诺赌场, 卡西诺牌戏
example: The country's new casino industry is increasing the number of gambling addicts.

meaning: n. the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit; n. systematic training by multiple repetitions; n. a task performed or problem solved in order to develop skill or understanding; n. (usually plural) a ceremony that involves processions and speeches
translation_zh: n. 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业；vt. 运用, 练习, 运动；vi. 练习, 锻炼
example: Regular exercise is good for your health.

meaning: pdf
translation_zh: [计] abbr. 概率分部函数（Probability Distribution Function）；Adobe Acrobat 可导出文档格式文件（可用Web浏览器显示）；Microsoft系统管理服务器包定义文件；NetWare打印机定义文件
example: The pdf plays an important role.

meaning: n. the act of exhibiting; n. a collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display
translation_zh: n. 表现, 展览会, 展览品；[医] 投药, 展览, 展出
example: His first solo exhibition took place in Barcelona in 1925.

meaning: v. regard something as probable or likely; v. look forward to the probable occurrence of; v. consider reasonable or due; v. look forward to the birth of a child
translation_zh: vt. 预期, 盼望, 期待
example: I expect him to arrive soon.

meaning: a. high in price or charging high prices
translation_zh: a. 贵的, 奢华的, 费用浩大的, 乱化钱的；[经] 高价的, 昂贵的, 浪费的
example: That car is very expensive.

meaning: v. make plain and comprehensible; v. define
translation_zh: v. 解释, 说明
example: Can you explain this to me.

meaning: n. a statement that makes something comprehensible by describing the relevant structure or operation or circumstances etc.; n. thought that makes something comprehensible; n. the act of explaining; making something plain or intelligible
translation_zh: n. 解释, 说明, 辩解, 表明；[经] 解释, 注释, 说明
example: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

meaning: v. travel to or penetrate into; v. examine minutely; v. examine (organs) for diagnostic purposes
translation_zh: v. 探险, 探测, 探究
example: We need to explore this carefully.

meaning: n. an additional edition of a newspaper (usually to report a crisis); n. something additional of the same kind; s. added to a regular schedule; s. further or added
translation_zh: n. 额外的事物, 另外的收费；a. 额外的, 特别的；adv. 额外地, 特别地, 非常地
example: Do you want an extra slice of cake?

meaning: n. the front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear; n. the general outward appearance of something; n. the striking or working surface of an implement; n. a part of a person that is used to refer to a person
translation_zh: n. 脸, 面容, 正面, 外观；vt. 面对, 朝, 正视, 面临；vi. 朝, 向；[计] 现场可改变的控制元件
example: She has a beautiful face.

meaning: n. a piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred; n. a statement or assertion of verified information about something that is the case or has happened; n. an event known to have happened or something known to have existed; n. a concept whose truth can be proved
translation_zh: n. 事实, 真实性, 真相, 细节, 论据
example: That's an interesting fact.

meaning: n. a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
translation_zh: n. 工厂, 产生地, 代理店；[经] 工厂, 代理店, 商行在国外的代理处
example: The new car factory employs thousands of people.

meaning: v. fail to do something; leave something undone; v. be unsuccessful; v. disappoint, prove undependable to; abandon, forsake; v. stop operating or functioning
translation_zh: vi. 失败, 缺乏, 中断, 衰退, 失灵；vt. 忘记, 使...失望, 缺乏, 不及格；n. 不及格
example: He failed the exam.

meaning: n. the season when the leaves fall from the trees; n. the lapse of mankind into sinfulness because of the sin of Adam and Eve; n. a lapse into sin; a loss of innocence or of chastity; n. a sudden decline in strength or number or importance
translation_zh: n. 落下, 瀑布, 采伐量, 下降, 落差, 降低, 堕落, 秋天；vi. 倒下, 落下, 来临, 失守, 阵亡, 下跌, 减弱, 倾斜, 垮台, 轮到, 变成, 降低；a. 秋天的
example: The leaves change color in the fall.

meaning: a. not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality; s. arising from error; s. erroneous and usually accidental; s. deliberately deceptive
translation_zh: a. 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的；adv. 不准确地, 欺诈地
example: That statement is completely false.

meaning: s widely known and esteemed
translation_zh: a. 出名的, 极好的
example: He is a famous actor.

meaning: n. a device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces; n. an ardent follower and admirer; v. strike out (a batter), (of a pitcher); v. make (an emotion) fiercer
translation_zh: n. 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者；vt. 煽动, 刺激, 吹拂；vi. 飘动, 成扇形散开
example: He is a big fan of that band.

meaning: n. a kind of imagination that was held by Coleridge to be more casual and superficial than true imagination; v. have a fancy or particular liking or desire for; a. not plain; decorative or ornamented
translation_zh: n. 想象力, 幻想, 喜好；a. 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高价的, 特级的；vt. 想象, 设想, 相信, 喜爱；vi. 想象, 幻想
example: I fancied a change of scene.

meaning: a. located at a great distance in time or space or degree; s. being of a considerable distance or length; s. being the animal or vehicle on the right or being on the right side of an animal or vehicle; s. beyond a norm in opinion or actions
translation_zh: a. 远的, 久远的, 遥远的；adv. 甚远地, 很, 到很深的程度, 到很远的距离
example: The store is not far from here.

example: 他大部分地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines; below lieutenant colonel and above captain; n. British statesman who was prime minister from 1990 until 1997 (born in 1943); n. a university student who is studying a particular field as the principal subject; n. the principal field of study of a student at a university
translation_zh: n. 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校；a. 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的；vi. 主修；[计] 主要, 主要刻度
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常重大的的解释。

meaning: v. be in charge of, act on, or dispose of
translation_zh: vi. 处理；vt. 管理, 控制, 维持, 达成, 经营, 运用
example: 我们需要逐步manage这个方案。

meaning: n someone who controls resources and expenditures; n (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
translation_zh: n. 经理, 管理员, 管理器；[计] 管理器
example: 这个处理者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. how something is done or how it happens; n. a way of acting or behaving; n. a kind
translation_zh: n. 样子, 礼貌, 风格；[法] 方式, 方法, 样式
example: 这个方式为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object; n. information (data or ideas or observations) that can be used or reworked into a finished form; n. things needed for doing or making something; n. a person judged suitable for admission or employment
translation_zh: n. 材料, 物资, 素材, 布料, 资料；a. 物质的, 肉体的, 重要的
example: 这个材料为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a remark that calls attention to something or someone; n. an official recognition of merit; v. make reference to; v. commend
translation_zh: n. 提到, 言及, 陈述；vt. 提到, 提及
example: 这个说起为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
translation_zh: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序；[医] [方]法
example: 这个方法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the military forces of a nation; a. of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare; a. characteristic of or associated with soldiers or the military; a. associated with or performed by members of the armed services as contrasted with civilians
translation_zh: n. 军队；a. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常军事的的解释。

meaning: n. a river in southwestern Alabama; flows into Mobile Bay; n. a port in southwestern Alabama on Mobile Bay; n. sculpture suspended in midair whose delicately balanced parts can be set in motion by air currents; s. migratory
translation_zh: a. 移动的, 易变的, 机动的；n. 活动物体
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可移动的的解释。

meaning: r in large part; mainly or chiefly; r usually; as a rule
translation_zh: adv. 大概, 大部分, 主要；[经] 大部份
example: 他大部分地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. unlawful premeditated killing of a human being by a human being; v. kill intentionally and with premeditation
translation_zh: n. 谋杀；vt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏；vi. 犯杀人罪
example: 这个谋杀为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing; a. characterized by or capable of producing music; a. talented in or devoted to music; a. characteristic of or resembling or accompanied by music
translation_zh: n. 音乐片, 音乐舞台剧；a. 音乐的, 声音美妙的, 喜爱音乐的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常音乐的的解释。

meaning: n. a person who owes allegiance to that nation; a. of or relating to or belonging to a nation or country; a. limited to or in the interests of a particular nation; a. concerned with or applicable to or belonging to an entire nation or country
translation_zh: a. 国家的, 国立的, 全国性的, 民族的；[经] 全国性的, 国家的, 国民的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常国家的的解释。

meaning: n. an indigenous person who was born in a particular place; n. a person born in a particular place or country; n. indigenous plants and animals; a. characteristic of or existing by virtue of geographic origin
translation_zh: n. 本地人, 土产, 当地人；a. 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常本国的的解释。

meaning: n. someone regarded as certain to succeed; n. a notation cancelling a previous sharp or flat; n. (craps) a first roll of 7 or 11 that immediately wins the stake; a. in accordance with nature; relating to or concerning nature
translation_zh: n. 白痴；a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常天然的的解释。

meaning: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but; r in a close manner
translation_zh: adv. 几乎, 密切地
example: 他几乎地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. absolutely essential; s. unavoidably determined by prior circumstances
translation_zh: a. 必要的；必然的；必需的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常必需品 adj. 必要的的解释。

meaning: n. a reply of denial; n. a piece of photographic film showing an image with light and shade or colors reversed; a. characterized by or displaying negation or denial or opposition or resistance; having no positive features; a. expressing or consisting of a negation or refusal or denial
translation_zh: n. 否定, 否定语, 负数, 底片；a. 否定的, 消极的, 负的, 阴性的；n. 负数, 负值；[计] 负数, 负值
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常拒绝的的解释。

meaning: n. a trap made of netting to catch fish or birds or insects; n. a goal lined with netting (as in soccer or hockey); n. game equipment consisting of a strip of netting dividing the playing area in tennis or badminton; n. an open fabric of string or rope or wire woven together at regular intervals
translation_zh: n. 网, 网状物, 罗网, 净利, 净价；a. 净的, 最终的；vt. 用网捕, 撒网, 净赚, 得到；vi. 编网；[计] 网络, 网络分析程序
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常网的解释。

meaning: n. an announcement containing information about an event; n. the act of noticing or paying attention; n. advance notification (usually written) of the intention to withdraw from an arrangement of contract; n. polite or favorable attention
translation_zh: n. 注意, 布告, 通知, 预告, 短评；vt. 注意, 通知, 评论, 提及, 关注；vi. 注意
example: 这个通知为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an extended fictional work in prose; usually in the form of a story; n. a printed and bound book that is an extended work of fiction; s. pleasantly new or different
translation_zh: n. 小说, 长篇故事；a. 新奇的, 异常的
example: 这个小说 adj. 新奇的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the verbal act of offering; n. something offered (as a proposal or bid); v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish; v. present for acceptance or rejection
translation_zh: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价；vt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出；vi. 出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚
example: 这个提供为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a worker who holds or is invested with an office; n. someone who administers the rules of a game or sport; a. having official authority or sanction; a. of or relating to an office
translation_zh: n. 官员, 公务员, 职员；a. 公务的, 官方的, 正式的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常行政官员的解释。

meaning: v. direct or control; projects, businesses, etc.; v. handle and cause to function; v. happen
translation_zh: v. 操作, 运转, 动手术, 活动
example: 我们需要逐步operate这个方案。

meaning: n. a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty; n. a message expressing a belief about something; the expression of a belief that is held with confidence but not substantiated by positive knowledge or proof; n. the legal document stating the reasons for a judicial decision; n. the reason for a court's judgment (as opposed to the decision itself)
translation_zh: n. 意见, 评价, 主张；[经] 意见
example: 这个意见为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
translation_zh: n. 机会, 时机
example: 这个机会为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. be against; express opposition to; v. contrast with equal weight or force; v. be resistant to
translation_zh: vt. 反对, 以...对抗, 抗争；vi. 反对
example: 我们需要逐步oppose这个方案。

meaning: n. something that serves as a model or a basis for making copies; s. preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed; s. (of e.g. information) not secondhand or by way of something intermediary; a. being or productive of something fresh and unusual; or being as first made or thought of
translation_zh: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的；n. 原物, 原作
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常起初的的解释。

meaning: n. the largest ocean in the world; a. relating to or bordering the Pacific Ocean; s. disposed to peace or of a peaceful nature
translation_zh: n. 太平洋；a. 太平洋的, 太平洋沿岸的, 爱好和平的, 安静的, 平息的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常和平的的解释。

meaning: v. make perfect or complete; a. being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish; s. precisely accurate or exact
translation_zh: n. 完成时；a. 完美的, 完好的, 理想的, 熟练的, 精确的, 完成式的；vt. 使完美, 修改, 使精通, 改善, 使熟练
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无瑕的的解释。

meaning: r. in a perfect or faultless way
translation_zh: adv. 完全地, 无瑕疵地, 完整地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. carry out or perform an action; v. perform a function; v. give a performance (of something)
translation_zh: vt. 进行, 履行, 完成, 执行, 表演；vi. 行动, 工作, 执行, 演出
example: 我们需要逐步perform这个方案。

meaning: n. a dramatic or musical entertainment; n. the act of presenting a play or a piece of music or other entertainment; n. the act of performing; of doing something successfully; using knowledge as distinguished from merely possessing it; n. any recognized accomplishment
translation_zh: n. 施行, 工作情况, 成绩, 行为, 表现, 演出；[电] 绩效, 性能
example: 这个表演为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r by chance
translation_zh: adv. 也许, 大概
example: 他假定地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. approval to do something
translation_zh: n. 许可, 允许；[计] 许可, 认可
example: 这个允许为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual; n. a person of considerable prominence
translation_zh: n. 个性, 人格, (团体、地方、国家)特有特性, 名人；[医] 人格; 个性
example: 这个人格为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit; a. relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy; especially physics; s. having substance or material existence; perceptible to the senses; s. according with material things or natural laws (other than those peculiar to living matter)
translation_zh: a. 身体的, 物质的, 自然的, 物理学的, 好色的；n. 体格检查
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常身体的的解释。

meaning: n. a full supply
translation_zh: n. 充分, 很多, 丰富；a. 很多的, 足够的, 丰富的
example: 这个丰富为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians; a. of or relating to your views about social relationships involving authority or power; a. of or relating to the profession of governing
translation_zh: a. 政治的, 政治上的, 政党的, 从事政治的；[法] 政治的, 政治上的, 党派政治的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常政治的的解释。

meaning: n. the people who inhabit a territory or state; n. a group of organisms of the same species inhabiting a given area; n. (statistics) the entire aggregation of items from which samples can be drawn; n. the number of inhabitants (either the total number or the number of a particular race or class) in a given place (country or city etc.)
translation_zh: n. 人口, 人口数；[化] 群体; 总体
example: 这个人口为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the particular portion of space occupied by something; n. a way of regarding situations or topics etc.; n. the arrangement of the body and its limbs; n. a job in an organization
translation_zh: n. 位置, 地位, 身分, 形势, 姿势, 立场, 职位, 状态, 阵地；vt. 安置, 决定...的位置；[计] 位置
example: 这个位置为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. by chance; r. to a degree possible of achievement or by possible means
translation_zh: adv. 可能, 也许
example: 他可能地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. possession of controlling influence; n. (physics) the rate of doing work; measured in watts (= joules/second); n. one possessing or exercising power or influence or authority; v. supply the force or power for the functioning of
translation_zh: n. 力, 体力, 力量, 势力, 动力, 权力, 强国, 乘方, 强度, 幂, 功率；vt. 使...有力量, 供以动力, 激励；[计] 乘幂; DOS外部命令:能控制许多电池电源计算机上的电源管理特性
example: 这个控制力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having great power or force or potency or effect
translation_zh: a. 有力的, 有权力的, 强大的；[机] 强力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常强大的的解释。

meaning: n. the force applied to a unit area of surface; measured in pascals (SI unit) or in dynes (cgs unit); n. a force that compels; n. the somatic sensation that results from applying force to an area of skin; n. an oppressive condition of physical or mental or social or economic distress
translation_zh: n. 压, 榨, 按, 强制, 压力, 压迫, 压强；vt. 迫使, 使增压, 密封
example: 这个压力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. keep from happening or arising; make impossible; v. stop (someone or something) from doing something or being in a certain state
translation_zh: v. 预防, 防止, 阻止, 妨碍
example: 我们需要逐步prevent这个方案。

meaning: n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth; n. satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements; n. the trait of being spurred on by a dislike of falling below your standards; n. a group of lions
translation_zh: n. 骄傲, 自尊心, 自豪, 精华, 勇气；vt. 以...自豪
example: 这个骄傲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the original amount of a debt on which interest is calculated; n. the educator who has executive authority for a school; n. capital as contrasted with the income derived from it; n. (criminal law) any person involved in a criminal offense, regardless of whether the person profits from such involvement
translation_zh: n. 校长, 首长, 本金, 主犯, 资本, 委托人；a. 主要的, 最重要的, 首要的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常最重要的的解释。

meaning: n. an enlisted man of the lowest rank in the Army or Marines; a. confined to particular persons or groups or providing privacy; s. concerning things deeply private and personal
translation_zh: a. 私人的, 秘密的, 私立的, 隐蔽的；n. 士兵, 隐士, 阴部；[计] 私人的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常私有的的解释。

meaning: n. an argument in favor of a proposal; a. in favor of (an action or proposal etc.); r. in favor of a proposition, opinion, etc.
translation_zh: adv. 正面地；[计] 可编程远程操作
example: 这个赞成者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an artifact that has been created by someone or some process; n. a quantity obtained by multiplication; n. a chemical substance formed as a result of a chemical reaction; n. a consequence of someone's efforts or of a particular set of circumstances
translation_zh: n. 产品, 结果, 乘积；[化] 生产物
example: 这个产品为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act or process of producing something; n. a presentation for the stage or screen or radio or television; n. (law) the act of exhibiting in a court of law; n. a display that is exaggerated or unduly complicated
translation_zh: n. 制造, 生产, 产物；[医] 产生, 生成
example: 这个生产为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person engaged in one of the learned professions; n. an athlete who plays for pay; a. engaged in a profession or engaging in as a profession or means of livelihood; a. of or relating to or suitable as a profession
translation_zh: n. 专业人才；a. 专业的, 职业的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常职业的的解释。

meaning: n. a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future; n. grounds for feeling hopeful about the future; v. make a promise or commitment; v. promise to undertake or give
translation_zh: n. 诺言, 约定的事情, 有指望；vt. 允诺, 约定, 预示；vi. 允诺, 有前途, 有指望
example: 这个许诺为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. marked by suitability or rightness or appropriateness; s. having all the qualities typical of the thing specified; not just a snack"; s. limited to the thing specified; s. appropriate for a condition or purpose or occasion or a person's character, needs
translation_zh: a. 适当的, 固有的, 高尚的, 专属的；adv. 完全地, 彻底地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常适当的的解释。

meaning: v. give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance; v. determine (what is to happen in certain contingencies), especially by including a proviso condition or stipulation; v. supply means of subsistence; earn a living; v. take measures in preparation for
translation_zh: vt. 提供, 供应, 规定, 预备；vi. 作准备, 抚养, 规定
example: 我们需要逐步provide这个方案。

meaning: v. prepare and issue for public distribution or sale; v. have (one's written work) issued for publication
translation_zh: vt. 出版, 发行, 公开, 发表, 宣传, 公布；vi. 出版, 发行
example: 我们需要逐步publish这个方案。

meaning: r. to a degree (not used with a negative); r. to the greatest extent; completely; r. of an unusually noticeable or exceptional or remarkable kind (not used with a negative); r. actually or truly or to an extreme
translation_zh: adv. 相当, 完全, 十分
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the amount a salary is increased; n. increasing the size of a bet (as in poker); v. raise the level or amount of something; v. raise from a lower to a higher position
translation_zh: n. 上升, 高地, 增高；vt. 升起, 举起, 唤起, 提高, 使出现, 使复活, 提出, 筹集, 饲养
example: 我们需要逐步raise这个方案。

meaning: n. the limits within which something can be effective; n. a large tract of grassy open land on which livestock can graze; n. a series of hills or mountains; n. a place for shooting (firing or driving) projectiles of various kinds
translation_zh: n. 排, 行, 山脉, 范围, 行列, 射程；vt. 排列, 归类于, 使并列, 放牧；vi. 平行, 延伸, 漫游；[计] 量程; 范围; 域; 距离
example: 这个范围为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit; n. amount of a charge or payment relative to some basis; n. a quantity or amount or measure considered as a proportion of another quantity or amount or measure; v. assign a rank or rating to
translation_zh: n. 比率, 率, 速度, 价格, 费用, 等级；vt. 估价, 认为, 鉴定等级, 责骂；vi. 被评价, 责骂
example: 这个比率为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. on the contrary; rather (or instead), he wrote her a letter"; r. to some (great or small) extent
translation_zh: adv. 宁可, 稍微, 相当
example: 他宁可地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. informal terms for nakedness; s. having the surface exposed and painful; a. not treated with heat to prepare it for eating; s. not processed or refined
translation_zh: n. 擦伤处, 半成品；a. 生的, 未加工的, 生疏的, 不成熟的, 阴冷的, 刺痛的, 擦掉皮的；vt. 擦伤；[计] 写后读
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常生的的解释。

meaning: n. a branch of an umbel or an umbelliform inflorescence; n. (mathematics) a straight line extending from a point; n. any of the stiff bony spines in the fin of a fish; n. cartilaginous fishes having horizontally flattened bodies and enlarged winglike pectoral fins with gills on the underside; most swim by moving the pectoral fins
translation_zh: n. 光线, 射线, 闪烁, 光辉；vi. 射出光线, 浮现, 放射光线；vt. 放射, 显出
example: 这个光束为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. new
translation_zh: a. 最近的, 近代的, 最新的；[经] 最近的, 新进的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不久前的的解释。

meaning: r. in the recent past
translation_zh: adv. 最近
example: 他最近地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. be relevant to; v. think of, regard, or classify under a subsuming principle or with a general group or in relation to another; v. send or direct for treatment, information, or a decision; v. use a name to designate
translation_zh: vt. 提交, 归诸于, 把...提交, 使求助于；vi. 提到, 涉及, 查阅, 查询, 咨询
example: 我们需要逐步refer这个方案。

meaning: n. a regular patron; n. a soldier in the regular army; n. a dependable follower (especially in party politics); n. a garment size for persons of average height and weight
translation_zh: a. 规则的, 常例的, 有秩序的, 整齐的, 等边的, 定期的, 经常的, 合格的, 常备军的；n. 正规军, 正式队员；adv. 经常地；n. 正常体；[计] 正常体
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常整齐的的解释。

meaning: v. i. & auxiliary. To owe; to be under obligation for.; v. i. & auxiliary. To be obliged; must.; v. i. & auxiliary. As an auxiliary, shall indicates a duty or; necessity whose obligation is derived from the person speaking; as, you; shall go; he shall go; that is, I order or promise your going. It thus; ordinarily expresses, in the second and third persons, a command, a; threat, or a promise. If the auxillary be emphasized, the command is; made more imperative, the promise or that more positive and sure. It is; also employed in the language of prophecy; as, "the day shall come when; . . . , " since a promise or threat and an authoritative prophecy; nearly coincide in significance. In shall with the first person, the; necessity of the action is sometimes implied as residing elsewhere than; in the speaker; as, I shall suffer; we shall see; and there is always a; less distinct and positive assertion of his volition than is indicated; by will. "I shall go" implies nearly a simple futurity; more exactly, a; foretelling or an expectation of my going, in which, naturally enough,; a certain degree of plan or intention may be included; emphasize the; shall, and the event is described as certain to occur, and the; expression approximates in meaning to our emphatic "I will go." In a; question, the relation of speaker and source of obligation is of course; transferred to the person addressed; as, "Shall you go?" (answer, "I; shall go"); "Shall he go?" i. e., "Do you require or promise his; going?" (answer, "He shall go".) The same relation is transferred to; either second or third person in such phrases as "You say, or think,; you shall go;" "He says, or thinks, he shall go." After a conditional; conjunction (as if, whether) shall is used in all persons to express; futurity simply; as, if I, you, or he shall say they are right. Should; is everywhere used in the same connection and the same senses as shall,; as its imperfect. It also expresses duty or moral obligation; as, he; should do it whether he will or not. In the early English, and hence in; our English Bible, shall is the auxiliary mainly used, in all the; persons, to express simple futurity. (Cf. Will, v. t.) Shall may be; used elliptically; thus, with an adverb or other word expressive of; motion go may be omitted.
