translation_zh: n. 情形, 境遇, 位置；[医] 情境, 处境
example: There is no doubt that the current situation is very serious.

meaning: n. sports equipment that is worn on the feet to enable the wearer to glide along and to be propelled by the alternate actions of the legs; n. large edible rays having a long snout and thick tail with pectoral fins continuous with the head; swim by undulating the edges of the pectoral fins; v. move along on skates
translation_zh: n. 溜冰, 冰鞋；vi. 滑冰, 滑过
example: They love to skate on the ice rink.

meaning: n. the sport of skating on a skateboard
translation_zh: n. 滑板运动
example: 这个溜冰板为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the sport of gliding on skates
translation_zh: n. 溜冰
example: 这个溜冰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. narrow wood or metal or plastic runners used in pairs for gliding over snow; v. move along on skis
translation_zh: n. 滑雪橇；vi. 滑雪
example: We plan to ski in the mountains this winter.

meaning: n. a sport in which participants must travel on skis
translation_zh: n. 滑雪运动, 滑雪术
example: 这个滑雪（运动）v.滑雪( ski的现在分词 )为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s experiencing or accompanied by sleeplessness; s always watchful
translation_zh: a. 不睡眠的, 睡不着的, 不休息的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常失眠的的解释。

meaning: s. ready to fall asleep
translation_zh: a. 困乏的, 欲睡的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常欲睡的的解释。

meaning: n. a share of something; n. a golf shot that curves to the right for a right-handed golfer; n. a thin flat piece cut off of some object; n. a spatula for spreading paint or ink
translation_zh: n. 薄的切片, 一部分, 菜刀；vt. 切成薄片, 切下；vi. 切；[计] 片
example: Would you like another slice of cake?

meaning: n. a small flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study; n. (geology) the descent of a large mass of earth or rocks or snow etc.; n. plaything consisting of a sloping chute down which children can slide; n. the act of moving smoothly along a surface while remaining in contact with it
translation_zh: n. 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片；vt. 使滑动, 偷偷放入；vi. 滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走
example: 这个& vi. 滑动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v take off weight; s being of delicate or slender build; s small in quantity
translation_zh: a. 瘦的, 苗条的, 微小的, 稀少的, 微薄的；vi. 变苗条；vt. 使苗条
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常苗条的的解释。

meaning: r. without speed (`slow' is sometimes used informally for `slowly')
translation_zh: adv. 慢慢地, 迟缓地
example: The snail moved slowly across the leaf.

meaning: r. with no problems or difficulties; r. in a smooth and diplomatic manner
translation_zh: adv. 平滑地, 流畅地, 流利地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n a light informal meal; v eat a snack; eat lightly
translation_zh: n. 小吃, 点心, 快餐；vi. 吃零食, 吃快餐
example: I usually have a snack in the afternoon.

meaning: n. the act of sliding down a snow-covered slope while standing on a snowboard
translation_zh: v. 测雪板(snowboard的现在分词 )；n. 单板滑雪; 滑板滑雪; 滑雪板
example: 这个滑雪板vi.参加滑雪（运动）（现在分词/动名词）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. to a very great extent or degree; r. in a manner that facilitates; r. in such a condition or manner, especially as expressed or implied; r. to a certain unspecified extent or degree
translation_zh: adv. 如此, 如是, 如...那样；conj. 所以, 因此；pron. 这样
example: 他这样地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats; n. money offered as a bribe; n. street names for gamma hydroxybutyrate; v. rub soap all over, usually with the purpose of cleaning
translation_zh: n. 肥皂, 阿谀；vt. 以肥皂洗, 阿谀；[计] 评语
example: 这个肥皂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization; n. the fashionable elite
translation_zh: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团
example: 这个社会为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee; v. hit hard
translation_zh: n. 短袜, 鞋垫, 一击；vt. 重击, 猛投, 给...穿袜；vi. 打击；adv. 正着地, 不偏不倚地；a. 非常成功的
example: 这个重击为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a sodium salt of carbonic acid; used in making soap powders and glass and paper; n a sweet drink containing carbonated water and flavoring
translation_zh: n. 苏打, 碳酸水；[化] 纯碱; 苏打; 碳酸钠
example: 这个苏打为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. yielding readily to pressure or weight; a. compassionate and kind; conciliatory; a. (of sound) relatively low in volume; a. not protected against attack (especially by nuclear weapons)
translation_zh: a. 软的, 温和的, 柔和的, 柔滑的, 温柔的, 软弱的, 坡度小的, 笨的, 纸币的；n. 柔软的东西, 笨人, 纸币；adv. 柔软地, 温和地
example: The pillow was very soft.

meaning: r. with low volume; r. in a manner that is pleasing to the senses
translation_zh: adv. 柔和地, 静静地, 温柔地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory
translation_zh: n. 软件；[计] 软设备
example: 这个软件为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army; n. a wingless sterile ant or termite having a large head and powerful jaws adapted for defending the colony; v. serve as a soldier in the military
translation_zh: n. 军人, 士兵, 兵蚁；vi. 从军, 尽职, 偷懒, 磨洋工
example: The soldier wore a green uniform.

meaning: n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution; n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem; n. a method for solving a problem; n. the set of values that give a true statement when substituted into an equation
translation_zh: n. 解决, 解答, 溶液；[化] 溶液
example: 这个（问题、困难等的）解决办法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a human being
translation_zh: n. 了不起的人, 大人物；pron. 有人, 某人
example: 这个大人物为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. some unspecified time in the future
translation_zh: adv. 有一天
example: Someday, I hope to travel the world.

meaning: n. an indefinite or unknown location; r. in or at or to some place; (`someplace' is used informally for `somewhere')
translation_zh: adv. 到某处, 在某处
example: I left my keys somewhere in the house.

meaning: n. a document (or organization) from which information is obtained; n. anything that provides inspiration for later work; n. a facility where something is available; n. (technology) a process by which energy or a substance enters a system
translation_zh: n. 来源, 水源, 根源, 原始资料, 源；[计] 来源, 源程序
example: 这个根源为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the region of the United States lying to the south of the Mason-Dixon line; n. the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees; n. a location in the southern part of a country, region, or city; n. the direction corresponding to the southward cardinal compass point
translation_zh: n. 南方, 南；a. 南的, 向南的；adv. 在南方；vi. 转向南方
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常南方的解释。

meaning: n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located; n. an empty area (usually bounded in some way between things); n. an area reserved for some particular purpose; n. a blank character used to separate successive words in writing or printing
translation_zh: n. 位置, 空间, 距离, 太空, 空白, 间隔, (期刊等的)篇幅；vt. 隔开, 分隔；vi. 留间隔；[计] 空白, 空格校验
example: There isn't much space in this room.

meaning: n a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)
translation_zh: n. 宇宙飞船
example: Astronauts travel in a spaceship.

meaning: n. spaghetti served with a tomato sauce; n. pasta in the form of long strings
translation_zh: n. 意大利面条
example: 这个意大利面条为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous); n. the presiding officer of a deliberative assembly
translation_zh: n. 说话人, 讲演者, 发言人, 喇叭, 扬声器；[计] 扬声器
example: The speaker gave an interesting presentation.

meaning: n. a medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease; a. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique; s. stated explicitly or in detail; a. relating to or distinguishing or constituting a taxonomic species
translation_zh: n. 特效药, 特性；a. 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常特殊的的解释。

meaning: n. distance travelled per unit time; n. a rate (usually rapid) at which something happens; n. changing location rapidly; v. travel at an excessive or illegal velocity
translation_zh: n. 速率, 速度, 迅速；vi. 加速, 超速, 快进；vt. 快速传送, 促进, 使加速；[计] 中央处理机速度设置程序
example: 这个加速为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. liquid that is spilled; n. the act of allowing a fluid to escape; n. a sudden drop from an upright position; v. cause or allow (a liquid substance) to run or flow from a container
translation_zh: n. 溢出, 溅出, 摔下, 溢出量, 木片, 小塞子；vt. 使溢出, 使散落, 洒, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下；vi. 溢出, 涌流, 摔下
example: 我们需要逐步spill这个方案。

meaning: n. extending the legs at right angles to the trunk (one in front and the other in back); n. a bottle containing half the usual amount; n. a promised or claimed share of loot or money; n. a lengthwise crack in wood
translation_zh: n. 劈开, 裂片, 裂缝, 分裂, 派系, 派别, 柳条；a. 劈开的；vi. 分离, 分开, 裂开, 被劈开；vt. 劈开, 切开, 使分裂, 使分离；[计] 拆分
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常劈开的解释。

meaning: n. a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food; n. as much as a spoon will hold; n. formerly a golfing wood with an elevated face; v. scoop up or take up with a spoon
translation_zh: n. 匙, 调羹, 匙形工具；vt. 以匙舀起, 调情, 使成匙状
example: 这个匙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. process or result of distributing or extending over a wide expanse of space; n. a tasty mixture to be spread on bread or crackers or used in preparing other dishes; n. two facing pages of a book or other publication; n. the expansion of a person's girth (especially at middle age)
translation_zh: n. 传播, 散布, 伸展；a. 双唇展开的, 伸展的；vt. 展开, 铺开, 传播, 推广, 伸出, 涂, 敷, 延伸；vi. 展开, 扩大, 传开, 延伸；[计] 展开
example: 这个& vi.伸开为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon; n. the product of two equal terms; n. something approximating the shape of a square; n. someone who doesn't understand what is going on
translation_zh: n. 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺；a. 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的；adv. 成直角地, 对准地；vi. 一致, 符合, 结清；vt. 使成方形, 使平方自乘, 调正, 结清, 使一致
example: The table has a square top.

meaning: n. a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments
translation_zh: n. 露天大型运动场；[医] 期, 病期
example: 这个运动场为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. personnel who assist their superior in carrying out an assigned task; n. a strong rod or stick with a specialized utilitarian purpose; n. the body of teachers and administrators at a school; n. building material consisting of plaster and hair; used to cover external surfaces of temporary structure (as at an exposition) or for decoration
translation_zh: n. 全体人员, 工作班子, 棍棒, 杆, 拐杖, 支柱, 权杖；a. 职员的, 雇员的, 参谋的；vt. 为...配备人员
example: 这个全体员工为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway
translation_zh: n. 梯级, 楼梯, 阶梯
example: He walked up the last stair to the second floor.

meaning: n. a type or class; n. a symbol that is the result of printing or engraving; n. machine consisting of a heavy bar that moves vertically for pounding or crushing ores; n. a block or die used to imprint a mark or design
translation_zh: n. 印, 邮票, 打印器, 戳子, 图章, 印花税票, 标志, 特征, 类型, 跺脚；vt. 盖章于, 顿足, 贴上邮票, 铭刻, 捣碎, 扑灭；vi. 捣碎, 跺脚
example: Don't forget to put a stamp on the envelope.

meaning: n. a message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc; n. (music) the presentation of a musical theme; n. a nonverbal message; n. a document showing credits and debits
translation_zh: n. 陈述, 指令, 声明；[计] 程序语句; 语句
example: 这个声明为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sculpture representing a human or animal
translation_zh: vt. 以雕像装饰；n. 雕像
example: There is a large statue in the park.

meaning: n. a slice of meat cut from the fleshy part of an animal or large fish
translation_zh: n. 牛排, 鱼排, 肉排
example: I ordered a medium-rare steak.

meaning: n. the act of changing location by raising the foot and setting it down; n. support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway; n. a short distance; n. a solid block joined to the beams in which the heel of a ship's mast or capstan is fixed
translation_zh: n. 步骤, 步, 步幅, 脚步声, 踏级, 步伐, 短距离, 步态, 手段, 等级；vt. 踏, 以步测量, 跨步, 使成阶梯状；vi. 跨步, 轻快地走, 跳舞, 踩, 踏上, 行走；[计] 步骤
example: Take one step at a time.

meaning: n. an ache localized in the stomach or abdominal region
translation_zh: n. 胃痛, 肚子痛
example: 这个stomachache（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a violent weather condition with winds 64-72 knots (11 on the Beaufort scale) and precipitation and thunder and lightning; n. a violent commotion or disturbance; n. a direct and violent assault on a stronghold; v. take by force
translation_zh: n. 暴风雨, 骚动, 风波, 风暴, 猛攻；vi. 起风, 猛冲, 怒吼；vt. 猛攻
example: A big storm is coming.

meaning: n. a kitchen appliance used for cooking food; n. any heating apparatus
translation_zh: n. 火炉, 窑；vt. 用火炉烤；stave的过去式和过去分词
example: She put the kettle on the stove to boil water.

meaning: n. a poker hand with 5 consecutive cards (regardless of suit); s. successive (without a break); a. having no deviations; a. (of hair) having no waves or curls
translation_zh: n. 直线, 直；a. 直的, 笔直的, 正直的, 直接的, 连续的, 整齐的；adv. 直接地, 立即, 不断地
example: Draw a straight line.

meaning: n. the branch of military science dealing with military command and the planning and conduct of a war
translation_zh: n. 战略, 策略；[经] 战略, 策略
example: 这个战略学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the property of being physically or mentally strong; n. the condition of financial success
translation_zh: n. 力量, 实力, 强度, 浓度, 人数, 抵抗力；[化] 强度
example: 这个力量为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a group's refusal to work in protest against low pay or bad work conditions; n. an attack that is intended to seize or inflict damage on or destroy an objective; n. a score in tenpins: knocking down all ten with the first ball; n. (baseball) a pitch that the batter swings at and misses, or that the batter hits into foul territory, or that the batter does not swing at but the umpire judges to be in the area over home plate and between the batter's knees and shoulders
translation_zh: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打；vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见；vi. 打, 打击, 抓, 罢工, 搏动, 触礁, 敲, 响, 穿透, 打动
example: 这个打为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with strength or in a strong manner
translation_zh: adv. 强有力地, 坚强地, 激烈地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a thing constructed; a complex entity constructed of many parts; n. the manner of construction of something and the arrangement of its parts; n. the complex composition of knowledge as elements and their combinations; n. a particular complex anatomical part of a living thing
translation_zh: n. 结构, 构造, 建筑物；vt. 构成, 组织
example: 这个结构为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. applying the mind to learning and understanding a subject (especially by reading); n. a state of deep mental absorption; n. a room used for reading and writing and studying; n. someone who memorizes quickly and easily (as the lines for a part in a play)
translation_zh: n. 学习, 研究, 学科, 论文, 求学, 书房, 试作；vt. 学习, 读书, 研究, 考虑, 计划；vi. 学习, 思索
example: I have a lot of study to do tonight.

meaning: n. miscellaneous unspecified objects; n. informal terms for personal possessions; n. senseless talk; n. unspecified qualities required to do or be something
translation_zh: n. 原料, 要素, 东西, 材料, 素质, 织品, 废物, 废话；vt. 装填；vi. 狼吞虎咽
example: 这个材料为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a particular kind (as to appearance); n. (botany) the narrow elongated part of the pistil between the ovary and the stigma; n. editorial directions to be followed in spelling and punctuation and capitalization and typographical display; n. a slender bristlelike or tubular process
translation_zh: n. 风格, 时尚, 文体, 风度, 字体, 类型；vt. 称呼, (根据新款式)设计, 使合潮流；n. 风格, 样式；[计] 风格, 样式
example: 这个风格为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. attain success or reach a desired goal; v. be the successor (of)
translation_zh: vi. 成功, 继承, 继续；vt. 继承, 接替
example: She worked hard to succeed in her career.

meaning: n. an event that accomplishes its intended purpose; n. an attainment that is successful; n. a state of prosperity or fame
translation_zh: n. 成功, 成就, 胜利
example: 这个成功为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with success; in a successful manner
translation_zh: adv. 成功, 结果良好, 有成就
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. of so extreme a degree or extent; r. to so extreme a degree
translation_zh: a. 如此的, 这样的
example: It was such a beautiful day.

meaning: v. imply as a possibility; v. call to mind
translation_zh: vt. 提议, 建议, 促成, 暗示, 启发, 使人想起；[法] 建议, 提出, 提议
example: 我们需要逐步suggest这个方案。

meaning: n. a set of garments (usually including a jacket and trousers or skirt) for outerwear all of the same fabric and color; n. (slang) a businessman dressed in a business suit; n. a petition or appeal made to a person of superior status or rank; n. playing card in any of four sets of 13 cards in a pack; each set has its own symbol and color
translation_zh: n. 套装, 诉讼, 请求, 起诉, 套, 组；vt. 适合, 使适应；vi. 合适, 相称
example: He wore a dark suit to the meeting.

meaning: n a portable rectangular container for carrying clothes
translation_zh: n. 手提箱
example: I packed my clothes in a large suitcase.

meaning: n. any plant of the genus Helianthus having large flower heads with dark disk florets and showy yellow rays
translation_zh: n. 向日葵
example: The sunflower turned its head towards the sun.

meaning: n. spectacles that are darkened or polarized to protect the eyes from the glare of the sun
translation_zh: n. 太阳镜, 墨镜, 太阳眼镜
example: 这个太阳镜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the rays of the sun
translation_zh: n. 日光；[医] 日光, 太阳光
example: Plants need sunlight to grow.

meaning: n. an exaggerated expression (usually of praise); n. the superlative form of an adjective or adverb
translation_zh: a. 最上的, 无比的, 过度的；n. 最好的人(物), 最高程度, 最高级
example: 这个最高的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n someone who is dazzlingly skilled in any field
translation_zh: n. 超级明星
example: 这个超级明星为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a light evening meal; served in early evening if dinner is at midday or served late in the evening at bedtime; n. a social gathering where a light evening meal is served
translation_zh: n. 晚餐
example: We usually have supper around 7 PM.

meaning: n. the activity of providing for or maintaining by supplying with money or necessities; n. aiding the cause or policy or interests of; n. something providing immaterial assistance to a person or cause or interest; n. a military operation (often involving new supplies of men and materiel) to strengthen a military force or aid in the performance of its mission
translation_zh: n. 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物；vt. 支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实；[计] 后援; 支持
example: 这个支撑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the sport of riding a surfboard toward the shore on the crest of a wave
translation_zh: n. 冲浪运动
example: 这个作冲浪运动 vt. 在…冲浪 n. 海浪为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the name used to identify the members of a family (as distinguished from each member's given name)
translation_zh: n. 姓, 别号, 绰号；vt. 呼以姓氏, 起绰号
example: What is your surname?

meaning: a. taken unawares or suddenly and feeling wonder or astonishment
translation_zh: a. 感到惊讶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使惊奇（surprise的过去分词形式） adj. 感到惊讶的的解释。

meaning: a. causing surprise or wonder or amazement
translation_zh: a. 令人惊讶的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使人惊讶的的解释。

meaning: v. continue to live through hardship or adversity; v. continue in existence after (an adversity, etc.)
translation_zh: vt. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于；vi. 活下来, 幸存
example: 我们需要逐步survive这个方案。

meaning: n. a small amount of liquid food; n. the act of swallowing; n. small long-winged songbird noted for swift graceful flight and the regularity of its migrations; v. pass through the esophagus as part of eating or drinking
translation_zh: n. 燕子, 吞咽, 喉；vt. 咽, 淹没, 吞没, 耗尽, 轻信, 忍受, 抑制；vi. 吞下, 咽下
example: He found it hard to swallow the large pill.

meaning: n. a crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body
translation_zh: n. 毛衣, 毛线衫, 运动衫, 出汗者；[化] 发汗器
example: 这个毛衣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person loved by another person; n. any well-liked individual; s. privileged treatment of a favored person or corporation (sometimes unethically)
translation_zh: n. 心上人, 爱人；vi. 爱慕；vt. 向...求爱
example: 这个爱人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. tight fitting garment worn for swimming
translation_zh: n. 游泳衣
example: Don't forget your swimsuit if you want to go to the beach.

meaning: n. a long and complex sonata for symphony orchestra
translation_zh: n. 交响乐, 交响曲
example: 这个交响乐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. instrumentality that combines interrelated interacting artifacts designed to work as a coherent entity; n. a group of independent but interrelated elements comprising a unified whole; n. (physical chemistry) a sample of matter in which substances in different phases are in equilibrium; n. a complex of methods or rules governing behavior
translation_zh: n. 系统, 体系, 制度, 方式, 秩序, 分类原则；[计] 系统; 体制; 体系
example: 这个（协同工作的）系统为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. as much as a tablespoon will hold; n. a spoon larger than a dessert spoon; used for serving
translation_zh: n. 大汤匙；[医] 汤匙, 大匙(15毫升)
example: Add two tablespoons of sugar to the mixture.

meaning: n. a person who possesses unusual innate ability in some field or activity
translation_zh: n. 天才, 才能, 有才干的人, 天资
example: 这个天赋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a small metal plate that attaches to the toe or heel of a shoe (as in tap dancing); n. a tool for cutting female (internal) screw threads; n. a plug for a bunghole in a cask; n. a light touch or stroke
translation_zh: n. 轻打, 水龙头；vt. 轻打, 轻敲, 敲打出, 选择, 装上嘴子, 使流出, 开发, 分接, 向...乞讨；vi. 轻叩, 轻拍, 啪塔啪塔地走；[计] 接头
example: Please turn off the tap when you're done.

meaning: n. a long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening; n. a recording made on magnetic tape; n. the finishing line for a foot race; n. measuring instrument consisting of a narrow strip (cloth or metal) marked in inches or centimeters and used for measuring lengths
translation_zh: n. 带子, 录音带, 磁带, 窄带, 卷尺；vt. 以带子绑起, 测量, 录音；[计] 带
example: Please pass me the sticky tape.

meaning: n. a reference point to shoot at; n. the location of the target that is to be hit; n. sports equipment consisting of an object set up for a marksman or archer to aim at; v. intend (something) to move towards a certain goal
translation_zh: n. 目标, 靶子, 指标；vt. 对准, 订指标
example: 这个目标为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. assign a task to
translation_zh: n. 工作, 任务, 作业, 困难的工作；vt. 派给...工作, 使辛劳；[计] 任务
example: Completing this task will take time.

meaning: n. a drop of the clear salty saline solution secreted by the lacrimal glands; n. the act of tearing; v. separate or cause to separate abruptly; v. to separate or be separated by force
translation_zh: n. 泪滴, 眼泪, 撕, 扯, 裂缝, 激怒, 飞奔；vi. 流泪, 撕破, 赶快, 飞奔, 被撕破；vt. 撕裂, 戳破, 拉掉, 撕掉, 使分裂, 使精神不安, 折磨
example: 这个流泪为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s being of the age 13 through 19
translation_zh: a. 十三岁到十九岁的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常青少年时期 adj. 青少年的的解释。

meaning: n a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
translation_zh: n. 十三岁到十九岁的少年
example: My cousin is a teenager.

meaning: n. the degree of hotness or coldness of a body or environment (corresponding to its molecular activity); n. the somatic sensation of cold or heat
translation_zh: n. 温度, 发烧, 热度；[化] 温度
example: The temperature dropped suddenly this evening.

meaning: v. fill with terror; frighten greatly
translation_zh: vt. 使恐惧, 恐吓
example: 我们需要逐步terrify这个方案。

meaning: n. a radical who employs terror as a political weapon; usually organizes with other terrorists in small cells; often uses religion as a cover for terrorist activities
translation_zh: n. 恐怖分子；[法] 恐怖份子, 恐怖主义
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常恐怖主义者的解释。

meaning: n. the words of something written; n. a passage from the Bible that is used as the subject of a sermon; n. the main body of a written work (as distinct from illustrations or footnotes etc.)
translation_zh: n. 文本, 正文, 课文, 主题, 圣经文句, 乐谱；[计] 电文; 文本; 正文
example: Please read the text carefully.

meaning: n. a book prepared for use in schools or colleges
translation_zh: n. 教科书
example: 这个教科书为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: theirs
translation_zh: pron. 他们的
example: 这个pro为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: pron. The plural of himself, herself, and itself. See; Himself, Herself, Itself.
translation_zh: pron. 他们自己, 她们自己, 它们自己
example: 这个他她为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
translation_zh: adv. 因此, 所以
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a criminal who takes property belonging to someone else with the intention of keeping it or selling it
translation_zh: n. 小偷, 贼；[化] 取样
example: The police caught the thief.

meaning: n. following the second position in an ordering or series; n. the musical interval between one note and another three notes away from it; s. coming next after the second and just before the fourth in position; r. in the third place
translation_zh: num. 第三, 三分之一；[机] 第三; 第三的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常第三三分之一的解释。

meaning: s. needing moisture; a. feeling a need or desire to drink; s. able to take in large quantities of moisture
translation_zh: a. 口渴的, 渴望的, 干燥的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常口渴的渴望[求]…的比较级:thirstier的解释。

meaning: n. the organized beliefs of a period or group or individual
translation_zh: n. 想法, 思想, 思维, 关心, 挂念；think的过去式和过去分词
example: 这个思想为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100; s. denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000 items or units
translation_zh: num. 千；a. 成千的, 许多的；n. 许许多多
example: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.

meaning: n. a storm resulting from strong rising air currents; heavy rain or hail along with thunder and lightning
translation_zh: n. 雷暴雨
example: We took shelter when the thunderstorm began.

meaning: n. receptacle that holds odds and ends (as sewing materials); v. put (things or places) in order; a. marked by order and cleanliness in appearance or habits
translation_zh: n. 椅子的背罩, 装杂物的容器；a. 整齐的, 有条理的；vt. 弄整齐, 收拾, 整理；vi. 整理, 收拾
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常整齐的的解释。

meaning: n. equality of score in a contest; n. a horizontal beam used to prevent two other structural members from spreading apart or separating; n. (music) a slur over two notes of the same pitch; indicates that the note is to be sustained for their combined time value; n. one of the cross braces that support the rails on a railway track
translation_zh: n. 带子, 线, 鞋带, 领带, 领结, 关系, 束缚, 平局, 不分胜负；vt. 系, 打结, 扎, 约束, 与...成平局；vi. 结合, 打结, 不分胜负
example: Can you help me tie my shoelaces?

meaning: n. skintight knit hose covering the body from the waist to the feet worn by acrobats and dancers and as stockings by women and girls
translation_zh: n. 紧身衣裤
example: 这个紧身衣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a schedule listing events and the times at which they will take place; n. a schedule of times of arrivals and departures
translation_zh: n. 时间表
example: Check the train timetable for departure times.

meaning: n. the extreme end of something; especially something pointed; n. an indication of potential opportunity; v. cause to tilt; v. mark with a tip
translation_zh: n. 顶, 尖端, 梢, 末端, 倾斜, 垃圾场, 小费, 轻击, 指点, 秘密消息；vt. 装顶端, 使倾斜, 使翻倒, 泄露, 告诫, 暗示, 给...小费, 轻击；vi. 倾斜, 翻倒, 倾覆, 踮脚走, 给小费；[计] 终端接口处理器, 提示, 技巧
example: 这个（使）倾斜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a heading that names a statute or legislative bill; may give a brief summary of the matters it deals with; n. the name of a work of art or literary composition etc.; n. a general or descriptive heading for a section of a written work; n. an identifying appellation signifying status or function: e.g. `Mr.' or `General'
translation_zh: n. 头衔, 名称, 标题, 书名, 扉页, 权利, 资格, 冠军, 字幕；vt. 授予头衔, 加标题于；[计] 标题
example: What is the title of this book?

meaning: n. slices of bread that have been toasted; n. a celebrity who receives much acclaim and attention; v. propose a toast to
translation_zh: n. 吐司, 烤面包, 干杯；vt. 敬酒, 烤, 使暖和；vi. 烤, 烘
example: 这个干杯为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one of the digits of the foot; n. the part of footwear that provides a covering for the toes; n. forepart of a hoof; n. (golf) the part of a clubhead farthest from the shaft
translation_zh: n. 足趾, 趾部, 脚趾；vt. 以趾踏触, 用脚尖走；vi. 动脚尖
example: 这个（人的）脚趾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the quality of a person's voice; n. (linguistics) a pitch or change in pitch of the voice that serves to distinguish words in tonal languages; n. a steady sound without overtones; n. a musical interval of two semitones
translation_zh: n. 音调, 音质, 语调, 语气, 色调, 气氛, 状况, 思想状态；vt. 给...定色调, 增强, 使...的声调和谐, 定音调；vi. 颜色调和；[计] 双音频
example: 这个语声调为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an ache localized in or around a tooth
translation_zh: n. 牙痛；[医] 牙痛
example: I have a terrible toothache and need to see a dentist.

meaning: n. small brush; has long handle; used to clean teeth
translation_zh: n. 牙刷
example: 这个牙刷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a journey or route all the way around a particular place or area; v. make a tour of a certain place
translation_zh: n. 旅游, 观光旅行, 任期；vi. 旅行, 周游, 巡回；vt. 周游, 观光, 游历, 使巡回演出
example: We went on a guided tour of the city.

meaning: n. someone who travels for pleasure
translation_zh: n. 观光客, 旅行者；a. 旅游的
example: Many tourists visit Paris every year.

meaning: n. a pair of parallel rails providing a runway for wheels; n. an endless metal belt on which tracked vehicles move over the ground; n. (computer science) one of the circular magnetic paths on a magnetic disk that serve as a guide for writing and reading data; n. a groove on a phonograph recording
translation_zh: n. 轨迹, 足迹, 径迹, 小道, 轨道, 磁轨, 途径；vt. 循路而行, 追踪, 通过, 用纤拉；vi. 追踪, 留下足迹, 沿轨道运行；[计] 跟踪
example: 这个足迹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the commercial exchange (buying and selling on domestic or international markets) of goods and services; n. the skilled practice of a practical occupation; n. the business given to a commercial establishment by its customers; v. engage in the trade of
translation_zh: n. 贸易, 商业, 交易, 生意, 职业, 顾客, 信风；vi. 进行交易, 做买卖, 经商, 对换, 购物；vt. 用...进行交换
example: 这个贸易为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an inherited pattern of thought or action
translation_zh: n. 传说, 传统, 交付；[法] 传统, 惯例, 移交
example: 这个传统为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. consisting of or derived from tradition; s. pertaining to time-honored orthodox doctrines
translation_zh: a. 传统的, 惯例的；[经] 传统的, 惯例的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常传统的的解释。

meaning: n. the aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time; n. buying and selling; especially illicit trade; n. the amount of activity over a communication system during a given period of time; v. deal illegally
translation_zh: n. 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量；vi. 交易, 做买卖；vt. 用...作交换；[计] 通信量, 传输量
example: 这个交通为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. activity leading to skilled behavior
translation_zh: n. 训练, 培养；[医] 训练
example: She is undergoing intensive training for the marathon.

meaning: v. travel by tram
translation_zh: n. 电车轨道, 煤车, 纬纱, 纬丝；vt. 用煤车运载；vi. 乘电车
example: 这个有轨电车轨道为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of going from one place to another; v. change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically; v. undertake a journey or trip; v. make a trip for pleasure
translation_zh: n. 旅行, 游历, 行进；vi. 旅行, 行进, 移动, 被传播；vt. 旅行, 通过, 使移动
example: Air travel can be expensive.

meaning: n. accumulated wealth in the form of money or jewels etc.; n. any possession that is highly valued by its owner; n. a collection of precious things
translation_zh: n. 宝物, 财富；vt. 珍爱, 重视, 秘藏
example: 这个金银财宝为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a cunning or deceitful action or device; n. a period of work or duty; n. an attempt to get you to do something foolish or imprudent; n. (card games) in a single round, the sequence of cards played by all the players; the high card is the winner
translation_zh: n. 诡计, 欺诈, 谋略, 恶作剧, 习惯, 决窍；vt. 愚弄, 欺骗, 装饰；vi. 哄骗, 戏弄；a. 有决窍的, 特技的, 欺诈的, 漂亮的, 靠不住的
example: 这个戏法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a source of difficulty; n. an event causing distress or pain; n. an effort that is inconvenient; n. an unwanted pregnancy
translation_zh: n. 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障；vt. 困扰, 麻烦, 使烦恼, 折磨；vi. 烦恼, 费心
example: 这个麻烦为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in accordance with truth or fact or reality
translation_zh: adv. 真实地, 不假
example: 他真实地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a fact that has been verified; n. conformity to reality or actuality; n. a true statement; n. United States abolitionist and feminist who was freed from slavery and became a leading advocate of the abolition of slavery and for the rights of women (1797-1883)
translation_zh: n. 事实, 实情；[法] 真实, 真相, 事实
example: 这个真理为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence; n. the property of producing accurately a note of a given pitch; n. the adjustment of a radio receiver or other circuit to a required frequency; v. adjust for (better) functioning
translation_zh: n. 歌曲, 主旋律, 心情, 声调, 和谐, 一致, 语调, 程度；vt. 为...调音, 调整, 调谐, 使一致；vi. 协调, 调谐
example: 这个曲调为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. two times
translation_zh: adv. 两次, 两倍
example: I have visited that city twice.

meaning: a. lacking or indicating lack of confidence or assurance; a. not established beyond doubt; still undecided or unknown; a. not certain to occur; not inevitable; s. not consistent or dependable
translation_zh: a. 不确定的, 无常的, 不确信的, 不可预测的；[法] 不确定的, 未定的, 不确信的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不确定的的解释。

meaning: a. conducive to or feeling mental discomfort; a. providing or experiencing physical discomfort
translation_zh: a. 不舒服的, 不自在的, 不安的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不舒服的令人不舒服的的解释。

meaning: v. know and comprehend the nature or meaning of; v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally; v. make sense of a language; v. believe to be the case
translation_zh: vt. 理解, 了解, 领会, 听说, 懂；vi. 懂得, 认为
example: 我们需要逐步understand这个方案。

meaning: s beneath the surface of the water; s growing or remaining under water
translation_zh: a. 在水中的；adv. 在水下
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常水面下的的解释。

meaning: a. lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance; s. relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
translation_zh: a. 心神不安的, 不自在的, 不稳定的, 不舒服的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不舒服的的解释。

meaning: a. not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception
translation_zh: a. 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正当的；[法] 不正直的, 不公平的, 偏颇的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不公平的的解释。

meaning: a. impossible to forget
translation_zh: a. 忘不了的, 令人难忘的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常难忘的的解释。

meaning: r. by bad luck
translation_zh: adv. 恐怕, 不幸的是
example: 他不幸地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. experiencing or marked by or causing sadness or sorrow or discontent; s. causing discomfort
translation_zh: a. 不快乐的, 不幸的, 不适当的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不幸福的的解释。

meaning: a. not in or exhibiting good health in body or mind; s. not conducive to good health
translation_zh: a. 不健康的
example: Eating too much fast food is unhealthy.

meaning: a. not important
translation_zh: a. 不重要的
example: The details are unimportant for now.

meaning: n. an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole; n. an organization regarded as part of a larger social group; n. a single undivided whole; n. a single undivided natural thing occurring in the composition of something else
translation_zh: n. 单位, 分队, 部队, 单元, 部件, 装置；a. 单位的, 单元的；[计] 单元常数; 部件
example: 这个(工作)单位(计量或计数用的)单位(课本中的)单元(特定功能的)装置为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the body of faculty and students at a university; n. establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching; n. a large and diverse institution of higher learning created to educate for life and for a profession and to grant degrees
translation_zh: n. 大学
example: She wants to go to university next year.

meaning: n. an unknown and unexplored region; n. a variable whose values are solutions of an equation; a. not known; s. not known to exist
translation_zh: a. 不知道的, 未知的, 陌生的；n. 未知物, 未知数
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常未知的的解释。

meaning: a. marked by dissimilarity; a. not equal in amount
translation_zh: a. 不像的, 不同的；prep. 不像, 和...不同
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常(表示属性)与…不像的解释。

meaning: a. not necessary
translation_zh: a. 不必要的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不必要的的解释。

meaning: a. disagreeable to the senses, to the mind, or feelings
translation_zh: a. 使人不愉快的, 使人厌恶的, 煞风景的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使人不愉快的的解释。

meaning: a. not usual or common or ordinary; s. not commonly encountered
translation_zh: a. 不寻常的, 罕见的, 与众不同的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不常见的的解释。

meaning: v. raise; a. being or moving higher in position or greater in some value; being above a former position or level; s. extending or moving toward a higher place; s. (usually followed by `on' or `for') in readiness
translation_zh: a. 向上的, 起床的, 涨的；adv. 向上, 上涨；prep. 在...上面, 向...的较高处
example: 他在上面地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: prep. On; -- used in all the senses of that word, with which it; is interchangeable.
translation_zh: prep. 在...之上, 迫近, 紧接着
example: 这个在上面 (prep.) - 位置关系为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of disturbing the mind or body; n. a tool used to thicken or spread metal (the end of a bar or a rivet etc.) by forging or hammering or swaging; n. the act of upsetting something; v. disturb the balance or stability of
translation_zh: a. 弄翻的, 混乱的, 心烦的；vt. 弄翻, 颠覆, 推翻, 打乱, 使不适, 使心烦；vi. 翻倒
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使心烦意乱的解释。

meaning: n. the act of using; n. a particular service; n. (law) the exercise of the legal right to enjoy the benefits of owning property; v. put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
translation_zh: n. 使用, 习惯, 使用价值, 用法, 使用权；vt. 使用, 利用, 运用, 耗费；vi. 惯常
example: 这个使用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. employed in accomplishing something
translation_zh: a. 使用过的, 二手的, 习惯的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常用（use的过去式）的解释。

meaning: a. being of use or service
translation_zh: a. 有用的, 有益的；[机] 有用的, 有效的
example: This tool is very useful for repairs.

meaning: a. occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
translation_zh: a. 平常的, 通常的
example: He took his usual route to work.

meaning: n. a long depression in the surface of the land that usually contains a river
translation_zh: n. 山谷, 溪谷, 流域, 凹地；[医] 谷
example: 这个山谷为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a numerical quantity measured or assigned or computed; n. the quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable; n. the amount (of money or goods or services) that is considered to be a fair equivalent for something else; n. relative darkness or lightness of a color
translation_zh: n. 价值, 价格, 购买力, 评价, 估价, 计算结果；vt. 评价, 估价, 重视；[计] 计算结果
example: 这个价值为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the word class that serves as the predicate of a sentence; n. a content word that denotes an action, occurrence, or state of existence
translation_zh: n. 动词；[计] 动词
example: In the sentence "She sings beautifully," "sings" is the verb.

meaning: n. the visual percept of a region; n. the act of looking or seeing or observing; n. the range of the eye; n. purpose; the phrase `with a view to' means `with the intention of' or `for the purpose of'
translation_zh: n. 视野, 风景, 见解, 视力, 观看, 视图, 指望, 意图, 印象；vt. 看, 考虑, 视察, 查看, 估量；[计] 视图
example: The view from the mountain was amazing.

meaning: n. a community of people smaller than a town; n. a settlement smaller than a town
translation_zh: n. 村庄；a. 乡村的, 村庄的
example: The small village was surrounded by green fields.

meaning: a. acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity; s. effected by force or injury rather than natural causes; s. (of colors or sounds) intensely vivid or loud
translation_zh: a. 暴力的, 猛烈的, 激烈的, 极端的, 凶暴的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常暴力的的解释。

meaning: n. bowed stringed instrument that is the highest member of the violin family; this instrument has four strings and a hollow body and an unfretted fingerboard and is played with a bow
translation_zh: n. 小提琴
example: She plays the violin beautifully.

meaning: n. someone who visits
translation_zh: n. 参观者, 游客, 访客；[法] 视察人, 检视人, 检查员
example: We had a visitor come to our house today.

meaning: n. a listing of the words used in some enterprise; n. a language user's knowledge of words; n. the system of techniques or symbols serving as a means of expression (as in arts or crafts)
translation_zh: n. 词汇(量), 词汇表；[计] 词表
example: 这个（某一语言的）词汇为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the distinctive quality or pitch or condition of a person's speech; n. the sound made by the vibration of vocal folds modified by the resonance of the vocal tract; n. a sound suggestive of a vocal utterance; n. a means or agency by which something is expressed or communicated
translation_zh: n. 声音, 嗓音, 嗓子, 愿望, 发言权, 表达, 喉舌, 语态；vt. 表达, 吐露, 调音
example: She has a beautiful singing voice.

meaning: n the act of traveling by foot; v use one's feet to advance; advance by steps; v accompany or escort; v obtain a base on balls; v traverse or cover by walking; v give a base on balls to; v live or behave in a specified manner; v be or act in association with; v walk at a pace; v make walk; v take a walk; go for a walk; walk for pleasure; s close enough to be walked to
translation_zh: n. 步行, 步态；a. 步行的, 步行用的
example: 这个步行为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money
translation_zh: n. 皮夹；[法] 皮包, 皮夹, 钱袋
example: I keep my money and cards in my wallet.

meaning: v. go via an indirect route or at no set pace
translation_zh: vi. 游荡, 漫步, 徘徊, 迷路, 离题, 蜿蜒；vt. 在...漫游
example: 我们需要逐步wander这个方案。

meaning: n. one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water); n. a movement like that of a sudden occurrence or increase in a specified phenomenon; n. (physics) a movement up and down or back and forth; n. something that rises rapidly
translation_zh: n. 波, 波浪, 波动, 起伏, 高潮, 潮涌, 挥手致意, (气压)突变；vi. 波动, 飘动, 挥手示意, 起伏；vt. 使波动, 使飘扬, 挥舞, 使成波浪形
example: The children played in the waves at the beach.

meaning: a. wanting in physical strength; s. tending downward in price; s. deficient or lacking in some skill; s. (used of verbs) having standard (or regular) inflection
translation_zh: a. 不牢固的, 弱的, 虚弱的, 软弱的, 无力的, 无权力的, (论据等)不充分的；[经] 疲软的
example: He felt weak after the illness.

meaning: n. the state of being rich and affluent; having a plentiful supply of material goods and money; n. the quality of profuse abundance; n. an abundance of material possessions and resources; n. property that has economic utility: a monetary value or an exchange value
translation_zh: n. 财富, 资源, 财产, 丰富, 富裕, 大量；[经] 财富
example: 这个财产为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving; n. an intricate trap that entangles or ensnares its victim; n. a fabric (especially a fabric in the process of being woven); n. membrane connecting the toes of some aquatic birds and mammals
translation_zh: n. 网, 蛛丝, 蹼, 织物, 圈套, 卷筒纸；vi. 结网, 形成网；vt. 织蜘蛛网于, 使落入圈套
example: 这个(蜘蛛等的)网周密的布置为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages on the World Wide Web
translation_zh: n. 网站（全球资讯网的主机站）
example: You can find more information on our website.

meaning: n. the social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed; n. a party of people at a wedding
translation_zh: n. 婚礼, 结婚, 结婚周年纪念日, 结合；[法] 结婚, 婚礼, 结婚纪念日
example: They are planning their wedding.

meaning: n. any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)
translation_zh: n. 周日, 平日；[计] 工作日
example: 这个平日为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a periodical that is published every week (or 52 issues per year); s. of or occurring every seven days
translation_zh: n. 周刊, 周报；a. 每周的, 一周一次的, 周刊的；adv. 每周, 一周一次
example: We meet weekly to discuss progress.

meaning: v shed tears because of sadness, rage, or pain
translation_zh: n. 哭, 哭泣；vi. 哭泣, 流泪, 哀悼, 滴落；vt. 哭着使..., 悲叹, 滴下
example: 这个哭泣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. have a certain weight; v. determine the weight of; v. to be oppressive or burdensome
translation_zh: vt. 称...重量, 衡量, 把...压弯, 考虑, 权衡, 起锚；vi. 称分量, 有意义, 重压, 起锚；n. 过秤, 称分量
example: We need to weigh the luggage before going to the airport.

meaning: n. the vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity; n. sports equipment used in calisthenic exercises and weightlifting; it is not attached to anything and is raised and lowered by use of the hands and arms; n. the relative importance granted to something; n. an artifact that is heavy
translation_zh: n. 重, 重量, 体重, 砝码, 重大, 影响, 力量；vt. 加重量于, 压迫, 使加权, 称重量；[计] 粗细
example: What is the weight of this box?

meaning: n. the countries of (originally) Europe and (now including) North America and South America; n. the cardinal compass point that is a 270 degrees; n. the region of the United States lying to the west of the Mississippi River; n. the direction corresponding to the westward cardinal compass point
translation_zh: n. 西方, 西部；a. 西方的, 向西的；adv. 向西, 自西方, 在西方
example: The sun sets in the west.

meaning: v. cause to become wet; v. make one's bed or clothes wet by urinating; a. covered or soaked with a liquid such as water; a. containing moisture or volatile components
translation_zh: n. 湿气, 潮湿, 水分, 雨天；a. 湿的, 潮的, 搞错的, 下雨的, 反对禁酒的；vi. 变湿；vt. 使...湿
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常潮的的解释。

meaning: s one or some or every or all without specification
translation_zh: pron. 无论什么
example: 这个无论什么为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a movable chair mounted on large wheels; for invalids or those who cannot walk; frequently propelled by the occupant
translation_zh: n. 轮椅
example: The hospital provides wheelchairs for patients.

meaning: n. a period of indeterminate length (usually short) marked by some action or condition
translation_zh: n. 一会儿, (一段)时间；conj. 当...的时候, 虽然；vt. 消磨
example: 这个当……的时候为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. all of something including all its component elements or parts; n. an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity; a. including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete; a. (of siblings) having the same parents
translation_zh: n. 全部, 全体, 整体, 完全之体系；a. 所有的, 完整的, 完全的, 纯粹的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常齐全的的解释。

meaning: pron. The objective case of who. See Who.
translation_zh: pron. 谁
example: 这个pro为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other; a. great in degree; s. having ample fabric; s. not on target
translation_zh: a. 宽的, 广阔的, 普遍的, 宽阔的, 广泛的, 一般的；adv. 广阔地, 遍及各处地, 广泛地；n. 大千世界
example: The river is very wide at this point.

meaning: r. to a great degree; r. so as to leave much space or distance between
translation_zh: adv. 广泛地
example: 他广泛地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a wild primitive state untouched by civilization; a. marked by extreme lack of restraint or control; a. in a natural state; not tamed or domesticated or cultivated; s. in a state of extreme emotion
translation_zh: n. 荒野, 荒地；a. 野性的, 野蛮的, 野生的, 失控的, 任性的, 杂乱的, 轻率的, 狂热的, 疯狂的；adv. 狂暴地, 失控地
example: We saw many wild animals in the forest.

meaning: s. resembling the wind in speed, force, or variability
translation_zh: a. 多风的, 风强的, 腹胀的, 吹牛的
example: It was a very windy day at the beach.

meaning: n. fermented juice (of grapes especially); n. a red as dark as red wine; v. drink wine; v. treat to wine
translation_zh: n. 葡萄酒, 果酒, 暗红色；v. (请)喝酒
example: Would you like a glass of red wine?

meaning: n. the contestant who wins the contest; n. a gambler who wins a bet
translation_zh: n. 胜利者, 优胜者；[法] 取胜者
example: The winner of the race received a medal.

meaning: n. a way of doing or being; n. United States Jewish leader (born in Hungary) (1874-1949); n. United States religious leader (born in Bohemia) who united reform Jewish organizations in the United States (1819-1900); a. having or prompted by wisdom or discernment
translation_zh: a. 明智的, 慎虑的, 聪明的, 博学的, 狡猾的, 机灵的；vi. 知道；vt. 教导, 告诉, 劝导；n. 方法, 方式；[计] 教育信息系统
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常聪明的的解释。

meaning: r on the inside
translation_zh: n. 内部, 里头；adv. 在内部, 在内心里；prep. 在...之内
example: 这个在内为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: prep. On or at the outside of; out of; not within; as,; without doors.; prep. Out of the limits of; out of reach of; beyond.; prep. Not with; otherwise than with; in absence of,; separation from, or destitution of; not with use or employment of;; independently of; exclusively of; with omission; as, without labor;; without damage.; conj. Unless; except; -- introducing a clause.; adv. On or art the outside; not on the inside; not within;; outwardly; externally.; adv. Outside of the house; out of doors.
translation_zh: prep. 没有, 不, 在...之外；adv. 在外面, 户外；n. 外面, 外部
example: 这个没有为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees; n. United States film actress (1938-1981); n. English conductor (1869-1944); n. English writer of novels about murders and thefts and forgeries (1814-1887)
translation_zh: n. 木材, 木制品；vt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴；vi. 收集木材
example: 这个木材为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a fabric made from the hair of sheep; n. fiber sheared from animals (such as sheep) and twisted into yarn for weaving; n. outer coat of especially sheep and yaks
translation_zh: n. 羊毛, 毛织物, 毛线, 绒线；[医] 羊毛, 绒毛, 棉[花]
example: This sweater is made of soft wool.

meaning: v be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy; v be concerned with; v disturb the peace of mind of; afflict with mental agitation or distress; v be on the mind of; v lacerate by biting; v touch or rub constantly; s afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief; s mentally upset over possible misfortune or danger etc
translation_zh: a. 担心的, 闷闷不乐的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常焦虑的的解释。

meaning: n. something inferior in quality or condition or effect; a. (comparative of `bad') inferior to another in quality or condition or desirability; a. changed for the worse in health or fitness; r. (comparative of `ill') in a less effective or successful or desirable manner
translation_zh: n. 更坏的事, 更恶劣的事, 败局；a. 更坏的, 更恶劣的；adv. 更坏地, 更恶劣地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常更坏的的解释。

meaning: n. the least favorable outcome; n. the greatest damage or wickedness of which one is capable; n. the weakest effort or poorest achievement one is capable of; v. defeat thoroughly
translation_zh: n. 最坏, 最坏的时候；a. 最坏的, 最恶劣的, 最不利的；adv. 最坏, 最糟
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常最坏的解释。

meaning: n. the act of creating written works; n. the work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect); n. (usually plural) the collected work of an author; n. letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language
translation_zh: n. 书写, 著作, 笔迹, 作品；[医] 书写
example: 这个书写为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r not only so, but
translation_zh: adv. (非正式)是, 是的
example: 他( yes的俗音)地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the time of life between childhood and maturity; n. early maturity; the state of being young or immature or inexperienced; n. an early period of development; n. the freshness and vitality characteristic of a young person
translation_zh: n. 年轻, 青年时代, 青年们, 青春；[法] 青年, 青年时期, 青春时期
example: 这个青年时期为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features; n. any of the regions of the surface of the Earth loosely divided according to latitude or longitude; n. an area or region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic; n. (anatomy) any encircling or beltlike structure
translation_zh: n. 地带, 带, 地区；vt. 环绕, 使分成地带；vi. 分成区；[计] 卡片顶部的三行区; 区; 区域
example: 这个（有某特色或作用的）地区为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship; n. a vaguely specified social event
translation_zh: n. 事件, 事务, 恋爱事件
example: 这个事情为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an administrative unit of government; n. a business that serves other businesses; n. the state of being in action or exerting power
translation_zh: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介；[化] 办事处
example: 这个代理为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. remote and separate physically or socially; s. having characteristics not shared by others; r. separated or at a distance in place or position or time; r. not taken into account or excluded from consideration
translation_zh: adv. 成零碎, 成距离, 分别地, 分离着；a. 分离的
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. from appearances alone
translation_zh: adv. 表面上, 清楚地, 显然地
example: 他据说地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. take possession of by force, as after an invasion; a. suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
translation_zh: a. 适当的；[经] 适当的, 拨出, 占用
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常适当的的解释。

meaning: n. a formal organization of people or groups of people; n. the act of consorting with or joining with others; n. the state of being connected together as in memory or imagination; n. the process of bringing ideas or events together in memory or imagination
translation_zh: n. 协会；[计] 关联
example: 这个协会为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization; v act or preside as chair, as of an academic department in a university
translation_zh: n. 主席, 会长；[经] 主席
example: 这个主席为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the status of being a champion; n. a competition at which a champion is chosen
translation_zh: n. 冠军身份, 冠军称号, 捍卫
example: 这个锦标赛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules; a. relating to or used in chemistry; a. of or made from or using substances produced by or used in reactions involving atomic or molecular changes
translation_zh: n. 化学药品；a. 化学的, 化学上用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常化学制品的解释。

meaning: n. a special group delegated to consider some matter; n. a self-constituted organization to promote something
translation_zh: n. 委员会；[经] 委员会
example: 这个委员会为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. something that interests you because it is important or affects you; n. an anxious feeling; n. a feeling of sympathy for someone or something; n. something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness
translation_zh: n. 关心, 忧虑；vt. 与...有关, 使担心, 使挂念
example: 这个涉及为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation; n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
translation_zh: n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉；n. 上下文；[计] 上下文
example: 这个上下文为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the formal presentation of a stated proposition and the opposition to it (usually followed by a vote); v. argue with one another; v. discuss the pros and cons of an issue
translation_zh: n. 辩论, 讨论；v. 争论, 辩论
example: 这个辩论为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person responsible for the editorial aspects of publication; the person who determines the final content of a text (especially of a newspaper or magazine)
translation_zh: n. 编者, 编辑, 主笔, 编辑器, 编辑装置；[计] 编辑器
example: 这个编辑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. for a very long or seemingly endless time
translation_zh: adv. 永远
example: 他永远地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. (computer science) a message or message fragment; n. a small package or bundle
translation_zh: n. 小包, 一批信件, 大量, 信息包；vt. 打包, 装进小包；[计] 分组, 分组报文, 数据分组
example: She bought a packet of biscuits.

meaning: n a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record); n a thing made to be similar or identical to another thing; n matter to be printed; exclusive of graphical materials; n material suitable for a journalistic account; v copy down as is; v reproduce someone's behavior or looks; v reproduce or make an exact copy of; v make a replica of
translation_zh: n. 打印份数, 复印份数；复制品；副本（copy的复数）
example: 这个抄写为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. having vision, not blind
translation_zh: n. 视觉, 视力, 观看；conj. 鉴于
example: 这个<口>因为为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a Spanish gentleman or nobleman; n. the head of an organized crime family; n. Celtic goddess; mother of Gwydion and Arianrhod; corresponds to Irish Danu
translation_zh: n. 西班牙贵族(或绅士), 先生, 阁下；vt. 穿上
example: 这个大学教师为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。
